sa: इदं तु त्रिषु लोकेषु महज्ज्ञानं प्रतिष्ठितम्। विस्तरैश्च समासैश्च धार्यते यद्विजातिभिः॥
en: It is a great source of knowledge all through the three worlds. It is possessed by the twice-born in detailed and compendious forms.

sa: महानतिक्रमो ह्येष तक्षकस्य दुरात्मनः। द्विजस्य योददद् द्रव्यं मा नृपं जीवयेदिति॥
en: The aggression of the wretch Takshaka is great, for he gave wealth to the Brahmana, so that he might not revive the king.

sa: ये पुरा कुरुराष्ट्राणि जहः कुरुधनानि च। ते नागपुरसिंहेन पाण्डुना करदीकृताः॥
en: They, who robbed the Kurus before of both territory and wealth, were now forced by Pandu, the lion of Hastinapur, to pay tributes."

sa: विदुरस्त्वथ तां श्रुत्वा द्रौपदीं पाण्डवैर्वृतान्। वीडितान् धार्तराष्ट्रांश्च भग्नदर्पानुपागतान्॥ ततः प्रीतमनाः क्षत्ता धृतराष्ट्र विशाम्पते। उवाच दिष्ट्या कुरवो वर्धन्त इति विस्मितः॥ १७
en: Having learnt that Draupadi had been won by the Pandavas and that the sons of Dhritarashtra, their pride being broken, had returned in shame, Vidura became exceedingly glad; and coming to Dhritarashtra, O king, Kshatta, (Vidura) said to him, “The Kurus are prospering from good luck."

sa: वैचित्रवीर्यस्तु वचो निशम्य विदुरस्य तत्। अब्रवीत् परमप्रीतो दिष्ट्या दिष्ट्येति भारत॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, the son of Vichitravirya, the king Dhritarashtra, becoming astonished, said in great joy, "What good luck! What good luck!"

sa: जातान् पुत्रान् स निर्वेदाद् धिग् बन्धूनिति चाब्रवीत् निःश्वासपरमश्चासीद् द्रोणं प्रतिचिकीर्षया॥
en: He always said in despondency, "Fie on those children and relatives that I have!" He always sighed thinking of revenging himself of Drona.

sa: देवता: पितरश्चैव भुञ्जते मयि यद्भुतम्। देवतानां पितॄणां च मुखमेतदहं स्मृतम्॥
en: The Devas and the Pitris eat what is offered unto me. I am. therefore, called the mouth of the Devas and the Pitris.

sa: ततस्तत् तादृशं दृष्ट्वा स एव भगवानृषिः। अभ्यवर्षत धर्मात्मा वसिष्ठो मुनिसत्तमः॥
en: Thereupon, seeing the kingdom in such a state, the illustrious Rishi, the best of ascetics. the virtuous-minded Vasishtha, thought of remedying the evil.

sa: धनुश्च हि शरास्तस्य कराभ्यामपतन् भुवि। वेपथुश्चापि तां दृष्ट्वा शरीरे समजायत॥
en: Seeing her, his body shook all over with emotion and his bow and arrows slipped from his hands and fell on the ground.

sa: जगतो यस्तु सर्वस्य विद्विष्ट कलिपूरुषः। यः सर्वां घातयामास पृथिवीं पृथिवीपते॥
en: O king, It was he who was the cause of the slaughter of all creatures and of the world, he ruined the earth.

sa: साम्याद्धि सख्यं भवति वैषम्यान्नोपपद्यते। न सख्यमजरं लोके विद्यते जातु कस्यचित्॥
en: Friendship never remains in the world in any one's heart without being worn out. Time wears it out and anger also destroys it.

sa: आकर्णाद् भिन्नवक्त्रश्च शरूको विभीषणः। त्रिशिस्त्रां भ्रुकुटिं कृत्वा संदश्य दशनच्छदम्॥ भुञ्जानमन्नं तं दृष्ट्वा भीमसेनं स राक्षसः। विवृत्य नयने क्रुद्ध इदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: The opening of his mouth was from ear to ear, his ears were like arrows, his visage was grim and his forehead furrowed into three lines. Seeing Bhima engaged in eating his food the Rakshasas, thus spoke in anger and with eyes expanded and lips bitten.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तं प्रयान्तं महाबाहुं कौरवाणां यशस्करम्। अनुजग्मुर्महात्मानो ब्राह्मणा वेदपारगाः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : When that that mighty-armed hero, spreader of the fame of the Kuru race, went away, the Veda-knowing Brahmanas followed him.

sa: नाम विश्राव्य तु बकः समभिदुत्य पाण्डवम्। भुजाभ्यां परिजग्राह भीमसेनं महाबलम्॥
en: Saying that 'He is no other than Baka,' he sprang upon the Pandava and clasped the greatly powerful Bhima by both his arms.

sa: क्षिप्रमेव यथा त्वेतत् कार्यं समुपपद्यते। अप्रमत्तो जगन्नाथ तथा कुरु नरोत्तम॥
en: O lord of the universe, O best of men, act soon with care in such a way as this task may be accomplished.

sa: तमिन्द्रः प्राह सुप्रीतो न तवास्तीह तक्षक। भयं नागेन्द्र तस्माद्वै सर्पसत्रात्कदाचन॥
en: Indra, being much pleased, told him, “0 i Takshaka, o king of the snakes, you have nothing to fear here from the snake-sacrifice.

sa: सुखिनी सा पुरा भूत्वा सततं पुत्रवत्सला। प्रपन्ना दीर्घमध्वानं संक्षिप्तं तदमन्यत॥
en: The affectionate mother, Kunti, though she had all along led a most comfortable life, now regarded the long journey as being very short.

sa: न चाहमीशा देहस्य तस्मान्नृपतिसत्तम। समीपं नोपगच्छामि न स्वतन्त्रा हि योषितः॥
en: O best of kings, I am not the mistress of my body; therefore I do not go near you. Women are never independent.

sa: तामुवाच ततो राजा सान्त्वयश्लक्ष्णया गिरा। देवी वा दानवी वा त्वं गन्धर्वी चाथ वाप्सराः॥ यक्षी वा पन्नगी वापि मानुषी वा सुमध्यमे। याचे त्वां सुरगर्भाभे भार्या मे भव शोभने॥
en: The king then addressed her in sweet words. "O beautiful one, O beauty of slender waist, be you a lady of the Deva or Danavas race, be you a maiden of the race of the Gandharvas or the Apsaras, be you a damsel of the Yakshas or the Nagas, or be you a human female, I solicit you to be my wife.

sa: छन्दं मुनेश्च विज्ञाय सीतायाश्च मनोगतम्। प्रत्ययं दातुकामायास्ततः शंसत मे लघु॥
en: Let the emissaries learn well the intention of the ascetic in this and if Sītā is at heart willing to bring in proofs.

sa: एवं पृष्टः स बहुशो रक्षमाणश्च पाण्डवान्। उवाच नागरान् सर्वानिदं विप्रर्षभस्तदा॥
en: Having been thus repeatedly asked by them that best of Brahmanas thus spoke to all the citizens in order to conceal the Pandavas.

sa: त्वं प्रमाणं प्रमाणानामसि राघव सुव्रत। विदितश्चैव ते धर्मः सद्भिराचरितस्तु वै॥ धर्माणां त्वं परं धाम गुणाना सागरोपमः। अज्ञानाच मया राजनुक्तस्त्वं राजसत्तम॥
en: O Rāghava, O you of firms vows—you are an example of examples. You are cognisant of the conduct of the pious. You are like an ocean, the refuge of all virtues. O foremost of kings, out of ignorance, I have spoken to you so many things.

sa: गोलांगूलांश्च भद्रं ते हर्याः पुत्रान्प्रचक्षते। प्रजज्ञे त्वथ शार्दूली सिंहान् व्याघ्राननेकशः॥
en: Those animals that are called Golangula also are said to be the offspring of Hari. Sharduli gave birth to innumerable lions and tigers,

sa: तामुवाच ततो राजा सान्त्वयश्लक्ष्णया गिरा। देवी वा दानवी वा त्वं गन्धर्वी चाथ वाप्सराः॥ यक्षी वा पन्नगी वापि मानुषी वा सुमध्यमे। याचे त्वां सुरगर्भाभे भार्या मे भव शोभने॥
en: The king then addressed her in sweet words. "O beautiful one, O beauty of slender waist, be you a lady of the Deva or Danavas race, be you a maiden of the race of the Gandharvas or the Apsaras, be you a damsel of the Yakshas or the Nagas, or be you a human female, I solicit you to be my wife.

sa: तस्मिन् निपतिते भूमावथ सा चारुहासिनी। पुनः पीनायतश्रोणी दर्शयामास तं नृपम्॥
en: On his falling down on the ground, that maiden of sweet smiles and of swelling and round hips, appeared again before the king.

sa: ततोऽहं सर्वभूतानां भावे विचरता शुभे। चोदिता तव पुत्रस्य मन्मथेन वशानुगा॥
en: O blessed lady, I was brought under the control of your son by the god of love who pervades the nature of everything.

sa: प्रभाते सुमहावीर्यः कृत्वा पौर्वाहिणकी क्रियाम्। मुनि प्राञ्जलिरामन्त्र्य ययौ पश्चान्मुखः पुनः॥
en: Having performed the morning rites after the expiration of the night and taken farewell from the ascetic Vālmīki, Lakşmaņa proceeded towards the west.

sa: श्रुतं हि तेन तदभूद्यथा तं राजसत्तमम्। तक्षकः पन्नगश्रेष्ठो नेष्यते यमसादनम्॥
en: He had heard all that had happened; he had heard that the best of snakes, Takshaka would take the king to Yama's, abode.

sa: पार्षतो दुपदो नामच्छत्रवत्यां नरेश्वरः। तस्मादाकृष्य तद् राज्यं मम शीघ्रं प्रदीयताम्॥
en: Drona said: The son of Prishata, Drupada is the king of Chatravati. Take from him that kingdom and bestow it soon on me.

sa: एकोऽप्यमात्यो मेधावी शूरो दान्तो विचक्षणः। राजानं राजपुत्रं वा प्रापयेन्महतीं श्रियम्॥
en: Even one single minister who is intelligent, heroic, self-controlled, and discriminating cunfers the greatest good on a king of on a king's son.

sa: सौतिरुवाच एलापत्रवचः श्रुत्वा ते नागा द्विजसत्तम। सर्वे प्रहृष्टमनसः साधु साध्वित्यथाब्रुवन्॥
en: Sauti said : O best of the twice born, hearing what Elapatra said, all the snakes exclaimed in joy, "Well said! Excellent man!"

sa: उत्पन्नः स जरत्कारुस्तपस्युग्रे रतो द्विजः। तस्यैष भगिनी काले जरत्कारुं प्रयच्छतु॥
en: Jaratkaru is (already) born; that Brahmana is now engaged in penances. Let him (Vasuki), at the proper time, give his sister to Jaratkaru.

sa: ते वयं धृतराष्ट्रस्य प्रेषयामो दुरात्मनः। संवृत्तस्ते परः काम: पाण्डवान् दग्धवानसि॥
en: "Let us (now) send words to the wicked minded Dhritarashtra, (saying), "Your great desire is fulfilled; you have burnt to death the Pandavas."

sa: सप्तमं भारते पर्व महदेतदुदाहृतम्। यत्र ते पृथिवीपालाः प्रायशो निधनं गताः॥
en: These are the matters elaborately narrated in the seventh Parva of the Bharata, in which all the chief and potentates mentioned were killed.

sa: एष मद्रान् वशे कृत्वा कुरूंश्च सह सोमकैः। चेदिकाशिकरूपांश्च कुरुलक्ष्मी वहिष्यति॥
en: He will maintain the Lakshmi(goddess of prosperity) of the Kuru dynasty by subjugating Madra, the Somakas with the Kurus, Chedi, Kashi and Karusha.

sa: तच्च तत्र कृतं कर्म तवापीदं सुखावहम्। भवत्यमुत्र चाक्षय्यं लोकेऽस्मिंश्च यशस्करम्॥
en: Such an act done by me will give you pleasure; it will (also) bring me fame in this world and eternal bliss hereafter.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच धृतराष्ट्राभ्यनुज्ञाता: कृष्णया सह पाण्डवाः। रेमिरे खाण्डवप्रस्थे प्राप्तराज्या: परंतपाः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having obtained their kingdom at the command of Dhritarashtra, those chastisers of foes, the Pandavas, sported with Krishna at Indraprastha.

sa: त इमे प्रसवस्यार्थे तव लोकाः समावृताः। प्रजायस्व ततो लोकानुपभोक्ष्यसि पुष्कलान्॥
en: These regions are shut against you, because you have no offspring. Therefore, beget off spring you will then enjoy various regions of felicity.

sa: संहारो हि यदा लोके भृगुणां क्षत्रियाधमैः। आगर्भोच्छेदनात् क्रान्तस्तदा मां मन्युराविशत्॥
en: O Pitris, when those wretches, the Kshatriyas, were exterminating the Bhrigus together with the unborn children to their race, anger filled my soul.

sa: शीलदाक्षिण्यमाधुर्यैराचारेण दमेन च। देवयान्यां हि तुष्टायां विद्यां तां प्राप्स्यसि ध्रुवम्॥
en: "You are sure to obtain that knowledge (of Sanjivini from the Rishi) by gratifying Devayani with your conduct, liberality, sweetness and general behaviour.”

sa: ततः सा नवमे मासि इला सोमसुतात्सुतम्। जनयामास सुश्रोणी पुरूरवसमूर्जितम्॥ जातमात्रे तु सुश्रोणी पितुर्हस्ते न्यवेशयत्। बुधस्य समवर्णं च इला पुत्रं महाबलम्॥
en: There upon in the ninth month, Ilă, having a beautiful waist, gave birth to a highly effulgent son, under the name of Pururavă, born of the lions of Budha, and equally graceful like him. and she handed over the highly powerful son to his father Budha.

sa: यो जात: कवची खड्गी सशरः सशरासनः। सुसमिद्धे महाबाहुः पावके पावकोपमः॥
en: Who rose as a mighty-armed hero with natural armour, sword, bow and arrows from the blazing fire, himself looking like a second fire.

sa: शणसर्जरसंव्यक्तमानीय गृहकर्मणि। मुञ्जबल्वजवंशादि द्रव्यं सर्वं घृतोक्षितम्॥ शिल्पिभिः सुकृतं ह्याप्तैर्विनीतैर्वेश्मकर्मणि। विश्वस्तं मामयं पापो दग्धुकामः पुरोचनः॥ तथा हि वर्तते मन्दः सुयोधनवसे स्थितः। इमां तु तां महाबुद्धिर्विदुरो दृष्टवांस्तथा॥ आपदं तेन मां पार्थं स सम्बोधितवान् पुरा। ते वयं बोधितास्तेन नित्यमस्मद्धितैषिणा॥ पित्रा कनीयसा स्नेहाद् बुद्धिमन्तोऽशिवं गृहम्। अनार्यैः सुकृतं गूढैर्दुर्योधनवशानुगैः॥
en: By the help of trusted and well skilled artisans, the enemies have nicely built this house with hemp, health, straw and Purochana desires to burn me after inspiring me with confidence. The wicked man, therefore, lives here, obedient to (the instruction of) Duryodhana. The greatly intelligent Vidura, knew this danger. Therefore, O son of Pritha, he told me of it beforehand. Knowing this, that well-wiser of ours. The younger brother of our father, out of affection for us, has told us about this house, so full of danger and constructed by the wretches under Duryodhana (who is) acting secretly (from behind).

sa: ईजे च स महातेजाः सर्ववेदविदां वरः। ऋषी राक्षससत्रेण शाक्तेयोऽथ पराशरः॥
en: But the greatly effulgent Parashara, the son of Shakti, the foremost of all persons learned in the Vedas, performed a great Rakshasas sacrifice.

sa: गृहाणेमं महाराज मया संवर्धितं सुतम्। आदाय पुरुषव्याघ्र नयस्वैनं गृहं विभो॥
en: O great king, take him now. He has been carefully reared by me. O best of men, taking him with you, go home.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततस्तत्कारणं राज्ञो ज्ञात्वा सर्वमशेषतः। देवव्रतो महाबुद्धिः प्रज्ञया चान्वचिन्तयत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having heard the cause (of his grief) from the king, the greatly intelligent and wise Devavrata thought for a while.

sa: हृद्गतं तस्य राजर्षेविज्ञाय हरसंनिधौ॥ प्रत्युवाच शुभं वाक्यं देवी रुद्रस्य संमता। अर्धस्य देवो वरदो वरार्धस्य तव ह्यहम्॥ तस्मादधं गृहाण त्वं स्त्रीपुंसोर्यावदिच्छसि।
en: There upon, cognisant of that king's intention, the goddess, with Hara's consent, said. Half of the boon, that you shall beg of us both, shall be granted by Mahādeva, and the other half shall be granted by me. Do you therefore beg of me the half.

sa: वयमेतदनिच्छन्तः सर्व एव पुरोत्तमात्। गृहान् विहाय गच्छामो यत्र गन्ता युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: We can not sanction this. Therefore leaving this excellent city and our houses, we shall go to the place where Yudhisthira is going.

sa: प्रतिगृह्य च तां पूजां पार्थिवाद् भगवानृषिः। उवाच मागधं राजन् प्रहृष्टेनान्तरात्मना॥
en: O king, the illustrious Rishi accepted the worship of the king and thus spoke to the king of Magadha with a delightful heart.

sa: पश्य बाहू सुवृत्तौ मे हस्तिहस्तनिभाविमौ। ऊरू परिघसंकाशौ संहतं चाप्युरो महत्॥
en: Behold my arms each like a trunk of an elephant. (Behold) my thighs like two iron clubs. (Behold) my chest, broad and adamantine.

sa: स यथासमयं चक्रे बलिं बलवतां वरः। ब्राह्मणांस्तु सुमन्त्रज्ञान् कारयामास मङ्गलम्॥
en: The best of strong men, the hero (Drona), entering at the proper time, caused Brahmanas versed in Mantras to celebrate the auspicious rites.

sa: रुरुरुवाच किमर्थं शप्तवान्क्रुद्धो द्विजस्त्वां भुजगोत्तम। कियन्तं चैव कालं ते वपुरेतद्भविष्यति॥
en: Ruru said : O best of snakes, why were you cursed by an angry Brahmana? And how long will your this body continue?

sa: त्वं वज्रमतुलं घोरं घोषवांस्त्वं बलाहकः। स्रष्टा त्वमेव लोकानां संहर्ता चापराजितः॥
en: You are the incomparable thunder, you are the roaring clouds, you are the creator and the destroyer of the worlds, you are unconquerable.

sa: कच्चित् पुरुषकारेण पुरुषः कर्म शोभयन्। लभते मानमधिकं भूयो वा भक्तवेतनम्॥
en: Docs a man who shows exceptional merit in an act get from you more regard, and also an increase of rations and pay?

sa: ततोऽर्धदिवसे प्राप्ते क्रूरकर्मा स राक्षसः। आगच्छद्बहुसाहस्रं प्राणिनां भारमुद्वहन्।॥ ततो ददर्श शत्रुघ्नं स्थितं द्वारि धृतायुधम्। तमुवाच किमनेन करिष्यसि॥ ततो रक्षः ईदृशानां सहस्राणि सायुधानां नराधम। भक्षितानि मया रोषात्कालेनानुगतो ह्यसि॥
en: There upon returning in the noon with many thousand animals, the night-ranger Lavana, of dreadful actions, espied Satrughna standing at the gate with a weapon in his hand. Thereupon he said: What shall you do with this weapon? O vile wight, enraged I have devoured many thousand persons holding weapons like you. I now perceive you have also been possessed by Kala.

sa: ऊचुश्चैव महात्मानो हर्षेण महता वृताः। उपपत्रं नरश्रेष्ठ तवैव भुवि नान्यतः॥
en: And those high-souled ones, exceedingly rejoiced, said: On earth, O crown of men, this can only be expected from you and nobody else.

sa: गङ्गायास्त्वपरं पारं प्राप्य यः स्नाति मानवः। त्रिरात्रमुषितो राजन् सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते॥
en: O king, going to the opposite bank of the Ganges and living there for three nights, one is cleansed of all his sins.

sa: महानदी च तत्रैव तथा गयशिरो नृप। यत्रासौ कीर्त्यते विगैरक्षय्यकरणो वटः॥
en: O king, there is a great river and there is also Gayashira and there is a banian tree called by the Brahmanas eternal.

sa: तेषूपस्पृश्य राजेन्द्र पदेषु नृपसत्तम। यत् किंचिदशुभं कर्म तत् प्रणश्यति भारत॥
en: O king of kings, O foremost of monarchs, bathing in these hoof-marks, O descendants of Bharata, whatever sin is committed is all destroyed.

sa: ब्रह्मणा तत्र सरसि यूपश्रेष्ठः समुच्छ्रितः। यूपं प्रदक्षिणं कृत्वा वाजपेयफलं लभेत्॥
en: A best sacrificial pillar was built on that lake by Brahma. He who walks round that pillar obtains the fruits of Vajapeya (sacrifice).

sa: सनत्कुमारः कौरव्य पुण्यं कनखलं तथा। पवर्तश्च पुरुर्नाम यत्र यातः पुरूरवाः॥
en: O descendant of Kuru, by Sanatkumar, as also the sacred Kankhala. Here is also the mountain called Puru on which was born Pururava,

sa: शशयानं च राजेन्द्र तीर्थमासाद्य दुर्लभम्। शशरूपप्रतिच्छन्नाः पुष्करा यत्र भारत॥ सरस्वत्यां महाराज अनुसंवत्सरं च ते। दृश्यन्ते भरतश्रेष्ठ वृत्तां वै कार्तिकी सदा॥ तत्र स्नात्वा नरव्याघ्र द्योतते शशिवत् सदा। गोसहस्रफलं चैव प्राप्नुयाद् भरतर्षभ॥
en: O king of kings, going to the inaccessible Tirtha, called Sashyana, where the cranes disappear in the forms of Susas and reappear every year in the month of Kartikeya and bathe in the Sarasvati. O descendant of Bharata, O best of the Bharata race, O greatly exalted one. O chief of men, one, bathing there, becomes like the moon and obtains the fruits of giving away one thousand kine.

sa: अहन्यहनि चाप्येवं याचतां सम्प्रदीयते। अन्ये च ब्राह्मणा राजन् भुञ्जतेऽन्नं सुसंस्कृतम्॥
en: O king, day after they were given away to all that asked for them. Besides Brahmanas were fed with food which was pure.

sa: अगस्त्य एव कृत्स्नं तु वातापिं वुभुजे ततः। भुक्तवत्यसुरोऽऽह्वानमकरोत् तस्य चेल्वलः॥
en: Then Agastya eat up all the cooked meat of Vatapi. When the dinner was over the Asura Alluvial began to summon him (Vatapi).

sa: अगस्त्य उवाच गवां दशसहस्राणि राज्ञामेकैकशोऽसुर। तावदेव सुवर्णस्य दित्सितं ते महासुर॥
en: Agastya said : O Asura, you have intended to give to each of these kings ten thousand kine and as many gold coins.

sa: सप्तमेऽब्दे गते चापि प्राच्यवत् स महाकविः। ज्वलन्निव प्रभावेण दृढस्युर्नाम भारत॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, when the seventh year passed, that highly learned man, called Dridasya came out of the womb blazing like fire.

sa: स हि तेषां महेष्वासो गतिरासीदनीकजित्। आदित्यानां यथा विष्णुस्तथैव प्रतिभाति मे॥
en: It appears to me that great bowman and the victor of armies (Arjuna) was their refuge, as Vishnu was that of the Adityas.

sa: ऋतुपर्णे गते राजन् नलो राजा विशाम्पते। नगरे कुण्डिने कालं नातिदीर्घमिवावसत्॥
en: O monarch, O lord of the earth, after Rituparna had thus gone away, prince Nala did not remain long in the city Kundina.

sa: कथं नु नारी भर्तारमनुरक्तमनुव्रतम्। उत्सृज्य वरयेदन्यं यथा त्वं भीरु कर्हिचित्॥
en: O timid one, is it possible that a lady, forsaking her dear and devoted lord, will ever select a second husband like yourself?

sa: लोमश उवाच स तु राजा महेष्वासश्चक्रवर्ती महारथः। बभूव सर्वलोकस्य मनोनयननन्दनः॥
en: Lomasha said : That great bow-man and car-warrior, that imperial king became the delight of the eyes and the mind of all men.

sa: तस्य तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा त्वरितोऽहमिहागतः। श्रुत्वा प्रमाणं भवती राज्ञश्चैव निवेदय॥
en: Hearing these words of his, I instantly came here. Do you, therefore, inform the king all about these words, which you have heard.”

sa: सा व्युष्टा रजनीं तत्र पितुर्वेश्मनि भाविनी। विश्रान्ता मातरं राजन्निदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: O monarch! the handsome lady having spent there the whole night at her father's palace and taken perfect rest, addressed her mother thus:

sa: अहं च तव माता च राज्ञस्तस्य महात्मनः। सुते दशार्णाधिपतेः सुदाम्नश्चारुदर्शने॥
en: O handsome looking one! myself and your mother are the daughters of that illustrious king, Sudaman, who is the ruler of the Dasharnas.

sa: बृहदश्व उवाच एवमुक्तो नलस्तेन न्यवसत् तत्र पूजितः। ऋतुपर्णस्य नगरे सहवार्ष्णेयजीवलः॥
en: Brihadashya said : Having been thus addressed, Nala, thus received, lived there in the city of Rituparna in company with Varshneya and Jivala.

sa: यदि कैश्चिदहोरात्रैर्न द्रक्ष्यामि नलं नृपम्। आत्मानं श्रेयसा योक्ष्ये देहस्यास्य विमोचनात्॥
en: If within a few days and nights I do not see king Nala, I will secure my own welfare by renouncing this body.

sa: लोमश उवाच युधिष्ठिरासीनृपतिः सोमको नामधार्मिकः। तस्य भार्याशतं राजन् सदृशीनामभूत् तदा।॥
en: Lomasha said: O king, O Yudhishthira, there was a virtuous king, named Somaka. He had one hundred wives, all suitably matched to him.

sa: सुकेशान्तानि चारुणि सुनासाक्षिभ्रुवाणि च। मुखानि राज्ञां शोभन्ते नक्षत्राणि यथा दिवि॥
en: The countenance of the kings, embellished with beautiful locks and fine noses and brows, glittered even as the stars shine in the firmament.

sa: देदीप्यमानां वपुषा अतीवसुकुमाराङ्गीं तनुमध्यां सुलोचनाम्। आक्षिपन्तीमिव प्रभां शशिनः स्वेन तेजसा॥
en: She also possessed extraordinarily symmetrical handsome limbs, slender waist and fair eyes; her splendour was supposed to ecclipse the light of the moon.

sa: तां रत्नभूतां लोकस्य प्रार्थयन्तो महीक्षितः। काक्षन्ति स्म विशेषेण बलवृत्रनिषूदन॥ सर्वे
en: O slayer of Bala and Vitra, the kings, desirous of getting that pearl of the earth, all desire to have her most eagerly.

sa: यवक्रीत उवाच यथा तव निरर्थोऽयमारम्भस्त्रिदशेश्वर। तथा यदि ममापीदं मन्यसे पाकशासन॥
en: Yavakrit said : O lord of the celestials, O chastiser of Paka, if you consider these my attempts as fruitless, as yours are,

sa: विकुर्वाणो मुनीनां च व्यचरत् स महीमिमाम्। आससाद महावीर्यं धनुषाक्षं मनीषिणम्॥
en: He roamed over the earth committing various mischiefs to the Rishis. He one day met with the intelligent and greatly powerful (Rishi) Dhanushakha.

sa: रुदतीं च स्नुषां दृष्ट्वा भार्यामाः परावसोः। सान्त्वयश्लक्ष्णया वाचा पर्यपृच्छद् युधिष्ठिर॥
en: O Yudhishthira, seeing his daughter-in-law, Paravasu's wife in tears, he consoled her with sweet words and asked her the cause of her grief,

sa: स वै प्रविशमानस्तु शूद्रेणान्धेन रक्षिणा। निगृहीतो बलाद् द्वारि सोऽवातिष्ठत पार्थिव॥
en: O king, he was there repulsed by a blind Shudra door-keeper; and he was stopped at the door and grasped by the man.

sa: तं स्म दृष्टवा सर्वे प्रत्युत्तिष्ठन्ति पावकाः। न त्वेनमुपतिष्ठन्ति हतपुत्रं तदाग्नथः॥
en: As his son was killed, the (sacrificial) fire, which used to welcome him every day, did not come that day to welcome him.

sa: परिष्वज्य च बाहुभ्यां प्रीतात्मा भगवान् हरः। पुनः पार्थं सान्त्वपूर्वमुवाच वृषभध्वजः॥
en: The exalted Hara, whose sign was the bull, (Shiva), cheerfully embracing Arjuna with his arins, again consoled him and thus spoke to him.

sa: तत एनं महादेवः पीड्य गात्रैः सुपीडितम्। तेजसा व्यक्रमद् रोषाच्चेतस्तस्य विमोहयन्॥
en: Thereupon the great god pressed his (Arjuna's) body and attacking him in anger with all his might, he deprived him of his consciousness.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्तो महाबाहुर्भीमसेनः प्रतापवान्। प्रणिपत्य ततः प्रीत्या भ्रातरं हृष्टमानसः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having been thus addressed, the mighty armed and greatly powerful Bhimasena cheerfully bowed down his head to his brother Hanuman.

sa: आस्माकं क्षत्रियकुले जन्म कश्चिदवाप्नुयात्॥ ब्राह्मणेभ्यो नमो नित्यं येषां भैक्ष्येण जीविका।
en: Let none of us again be born in the order of Kshatriya. Daily salutation to the Brahmanas whose mode of life is mendicancy.

sa: तं दृष्ट्वा तत्र कौन्तेयं प्रगृहीतशरासनम्। अब्रुवन् ब्राह्मणाः सिद्धा भूतान्यन्तर्हितानि च॥
en: Seeing the son of Kunti, about to start, thus armed with bow and arrows, the Brahmanas, the Siddhas and the invisible spirits said.

sa: एवं बलवतः सर्वमिति बुद्ध्वा महीपते। जहि शत्रून् महाबाहो परां निकृतिमास्थितः॥
en: O mighty armed hero, O ruler of the world, thus everything belongs to those that possess might. Destroy enemy by means of stratagem.

sa: नैवधर्मेण तद् राज्यं नार्जवेन न चौजसा। अक्षकूटमधिष्ठाय हृतं दुर्योधनेन वै॥
en: Your kingdom has been robbed by Duryodhana by an unfair gambling at dice and not by virtue or by honesty or by prowess.

sa: निर्घातश्चाभवद् भीमो भीमे विक्रममास्थिते। चचाल पृथिवी चापि पांसुवर्षं पपात च॥
en: As Bhima displayed his prowess dreadful sounds of explosions rang through the sky; the earth began to tremble and dust fell in showers.

sa: न फलादर्शनाद्धर्मः शङ्कितव्यो न देवताः। यष्टव्यं च प्रयत्नेन दातव्यं चानसूयता॥
en: For not seeing the fruit you should not doubt religion or the gods; you should perform sacrifices assiduously and charities without any insolence.

sa: यथा वायोस्तृणाचाणि वशं यान्ति बलीयसः। धातुरेवं वशं यान्ति सर्वभूतानि भारत॥
en: As light straws are brought to the subjugation of the strong wind, so all creatures, O descendant of Bharata, depend upon the Creator.

sa: स्वाहाकारैः स्वधाभिश्च पुजाभिरपि च द्विजान्। दैवतानि पितॄश्चैव सततं पार्थ सेवसे।॥
en: O son of Pritha, with Yvahas and Svaddhas and other forms of worship you ever adore the Brahmanas, the celestials and the Pitris.

sa: ताः क्षिपेरन् प्रजाः सर्वाः क्षिप्रं द्रौपदि तादृशे। तस्मान्मन्युर्विनाशाय प्रजानामभवाय च॥
en: If the kings yield to anger, O Draupadi, their subjects soon meet with ruin. Thus anger brings on destruction and distress of mankind.

sa: यो देवांश्च मनुष्यांश्च सर्वांश्चैकरथोऽजयत्॥ तं ते वनगतं दृष्ट्वा कस्मान्मन्युर्न वर्धते।
en: O Bharata, who mounted on a single car, vanquished men and serpents. Beholding him in the forest why is not your anger excited?

sa: एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु कुबेरो नरवाहनः। दर्शयामास मां राजॅल्लक्ष्म्या परमया युतः॥
en: And, at the very moment, O king, Kubera, of transcendental beauty who is carried on the shoulders of men, came to my presence.

sa: प्रदक्षिणमुपावृत्य समारोहं रथोत्तमम्। चोदयामास स हयान् मनोमारुतहंसः॥ मातलिहयतत्त्वज्ञो यथावद् भूरिदक्षिण: अवैक्षत च मे वर्क स्थितस्याथ स सारथिः॥ तथा भ्रान्ते रथे राजन् विस्मितश्चेदमब्रवीत्। अत्यद्भुतमिदं त्वद्य विचित्रं प्रतिभाति मे॥
en: And going round it, I ascended that excellent car. And the exceedingly generous Matali, expert in horse-flesh, properly drove the horses fleet as the mind or the wind. (And)o king that charioteer, seeing that I was steadily seated in the car in motion, looked at my face and being lost in wonder said, “Today it appears to me highly wonderful and unprecedented,

sa: अप्रमेयोऽप्रधृष्यश्च युद्धेष्वप्रतिमस्तथा। अजेयस्त्वं हि संग्रामे सर्वैरपि सुरासुरैः। अथाब्रवीत् पुनर्देवः सम्प्रहृष्टतनूरुहः॥
en: You are incomprehensible in strength, irrepressible and also incomparable in fight.” Then with the hair of his body standing erect he said again,

sa: अर्जुन उवाच ततोऽहं स्तूयमानस्तु तत्र तत्र महर्षिभिः। अपश्यमुदधिं भीममपां पतिमथाव्ययम्॥
en: Arjuna said ; Then praised by the great sages here and there, I (at length) beheld the dreadful oceanthe inexhaustible lord of waters.

sa: संहरस्व पुनर्बाणमवध्योऽयं त्वया रणे। एतस्य च शरस्याजौ नावध्योऽस्ति पुमान् क्वचित्।।
en: There is none who cannot be killed by that arrow. He is however unslayable by you in battle, therefore draw back the arrow.

sa: आहूय शाल्वं समरे ततः प्रध्माप्य जलजं पाञ्चजन्यमहं नृप। युद्धाय समवस्थितः॥
en: Thereupon O king, blowing my conch, called Panchajanya, obtained from the ocean and inviting Shalva to an encounter 1 prepared myself for battle.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तस्यां रात्र्यां व्यतीतायांधर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः। उत्थायावश्यकार्याणि कृतवान् भ्रातृभिः सह॥
en: Vaishampayana said : The night being spent, Yudhishthira, the foremost of the virtuous awoke and performed the necessary duties together with his brothers.

sa: तस्मिंश्च तादृशे काले नारदचोदितः सुरैः। आगम्याह वचः पार्थं श्रवणीयमिदं नृप॥
en: (And)O king, at that very time, Narada, sent by the celestials, arrived (there) and spoke to Partha these words grateful to the ear:

sa: रात्रौ निशीथे त्वाभीले गतेऽर्धसमये नृप। प्रचारे पुरुषादानां रक्षसां घोरकर्मणाम्॥ तद् वनं तापसा नित्यं गोपाश्च वनचारिणः। दूरात् परिहरन्ति स्म पुरुषादभयात् किल॥
en: O king, after the dreadful hours of midnight were passed and when all nature fell asleep, then man-eating Rakshasass of fearful deeds began to wander. (Therefore) the ascetics, the cowherds and other rangers of forest used to shun that forest for the fear of the cannibals.

sa: सरस्वतीदृषद्वत्यौ यमुनां च निषेव्य ते। ययुर्वनेनैव वनं सततं पश्चिमां दिशम्॥
en: Performing their ablutions in the Sarasvati, the Drisadvati and the Yamuna and went from one forest to another travelling in the westerly direction.

sa: ततो मृगसहराणि मृगेन्द्राणां शतानि च। पतितानि वने दृष्ट्वा मार्ग तस्याविशनृपः॥
en: Then beholding many thousands of deer and hundreds of lions lying (dead) in that forest, the king became aware of his (Bhima's) route.

sa: वृष्णयो वा महेष्वासाः पाञ्चाला वा महारथाः॥ तेन सत्याभिसंधेन वासुदेवेन रक्षिताः।
en: The mighty bowmen of the Vrishni race, and the mighty Panchala car warriors will not suffer this in silence. Supported by Vasudeva (Krishna),

sa: धौम्यश्चैव कथं क्षत्तद्रौपदी च यशस्विनी। श्रोतुमिच्छाम्यहं सर्वं तेषां शंस विचेष्टितम्॥
en: O Khattwa, how does Dhaumya? How does the illustrious Draupadi (proceed along)? I desire to hear everything. Describe to me all their acts.

sa: मृतो ह्ययमुपानीतः कथं जीवितमाप्तवान्। किमेतत् तपसो वीर्यं येनायं जीवितः पुनः॥
en: How has the dead been restored to life? Is it by the strength of asceticism that he has been brought to life again?

sa: स तत्र ववृधे मत्स्यः किंचित्कालमरिदम। ततः पुनर्मनुं दृष्ट्वा मत्स्यो वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: O chastiser of foes, the fish there also began to grow for some time and then seeing Manu it spoke to him thus,

sa: धर्मिष्ठाः परिहीयन्ते पापीयान् वर्धते जनः। धर्मस्य बलहानिः स्यादधर्मश्च बली तथा॥
en: The virtuous men do not prosper, only the sinful men then exceedingly prosper. Virtue then loses her strength and sin becomes all powerful.

sa: तां वेपमानां सवीडां प्रलपन्तीं स्म पाण्डवान्। दुःशासनः सभामध्ये विचकर्ष तपस्विनीम्॥
en: Thereupon Dushasana began to drag in the assembly the helpless, modest and ascetic Draupadi who was trembling and weeping piteously to the Pandavas.

sa: पश्यामि च महीपाल पर्वतं गन्धमादनम्। मन्दर मनुजव्याघ्र नीलं चापि महागिरिम्॥
en: O ruler of earth, I saw also the mountain Gandhamadana and foremost of men, I also saw Mandara and the great mountain Nila.

sa: ततो बालेन तेनास्यं सहसा विवृतं कृतम्। तस्याहमवशो वक्त्रे दैवयोगात् प्रवेशितः॥
en: Then suddenly that boy opened his mouth and as fate would have it, I having lost all power of locomotion, entered his mouth.

sa: कुक्षौ तस्य नरव्याघ्र प्रविष्टः संचरन् दिशः। शक्रादींश्चापि पश्यामि कृत्स्नान् देवगणानहम्॥
en: O foremost of men, having entered his stomach, as I wandered about, I saw the whole race of the celestials, Indra and others,

sa: सत्यावादी मृदुर्दान्तः प्रजानां रक्षणे रतः। चरधर्मं त्यजाधर्मं पितृन् देवांश्च पूजय॥
en: Be truthful, be self-controlled, be ever engaged in protecting your subjects. Practise virtue and avoid sin and worship the Pitris and he celestials.

sa: तयैवंविधया राजन् पाञ्चाल्याहं सुमध्यया। ग्लहं दीव्यामि चावल्या द्रौपद्या हन्त सौबल॥
en: O king, O son of Subala, making that princess of Panchala, the slender-waisted Draupadi, as my stake, I shall (now) play with you.

sa: आभाति पद्मवद् वक्त्रं सस्वेदं मल्लिकेव च। वेदिमध्या दीर्घकेशी ताम्रास्या नातिलोमशा॥
en: Whose face when covered with sweat looks like the lotus or the wasp, who possesses flowing hair, red lips and body without down;

sa: चामरे चापि शुद्ध द्वे यमौ जगृहतुस्तथा। उपागृहणाद् यमिन्द्राय पुराकल्पे प्रजापतिः॥
en: The twins (Nakula and Sahadeva) held two excellent chamaras in their hands which was presented by Prajapati to Indra in a former Kalpa.

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच प्रश्नमेतं समुद्दिष्टं ब्राह्मणेन युधिष्ठिर। व्याधस्तु कथयामास ब्राह्मणाय महात्मने।॥
en: Markandeya said : O Yudhishthira, this question being put to the fowler by the Brahmana, the fowler thus replied to that high-souled Brahmana.

sa: शकुनिरुवाच दुर्योधनो महाराज विवर्णो हरिणः कृशः। दीनश्चिन्तापरचैव तं विद्धि मनुजाधिप॥
en: Shakuni said O great king, O best of the Bharata race, know that Duryodhana has become colourless, pale, and emaciated with anxiety. came

sa: एतदर्थं मम प्राणा भार्या पुत्रः सुहृज्जनः। सपुत्रदारः सुश्रूषां नित्यमेव करोम्यहम्॥
en: My five vital airs, my wife, children and friends are all for them. With my wife and my children, I always serve them.

sa: कथं तु दैवं शक्येत पौरुषेण प्रबाधितुम्। अवश्यमेव भविता यदुक्तं परमर्षिणा॥
en: He said to himself, "what the great Rishi has said must came to pass. How can fates be warded off by human exertions?

sa: आपृच्छे त्वां गमिष्यामि पूजितोऽस्मि विशाम्पते। एवमुक्तः स कृष्णेन धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: O king, with your permission I shall (now) go. I have been duly worshipped”. Having been thus addressed by Krishna (Vyasa), Dharmaraja Yudhishthira,

sa: पुरंदरस्तु तामाह मा भर्नास्ति भयं तव। एवमुक्त्वा ततोऽपश्यत् केशिनं स्थितमग्रतः॥
en: Purandara said to her, “Don't be afraid; you have no fear.” When he said this he saw Keshin (an Asura) standing before him.

sa: ब्रह्मोवाच मयतच्चिन्तितं कार्यं त्वया दानवसूदन। तथा स भविता गर्भो बलवानुरुविक्रमः॥
en: Brahma said: O slayer of Danavas, it shall be as you desire. The issue of this union will be very powerful and mighty.

sa: भूलिङ्गशकुनि म पार्श्वे हिमवतः परे। भीष्म तस्या सदा वाचः श्रूयन्तेऽर्थविगर्हिताः॥
en: O Bhishma, there was a bird, called Bhulinga living on the other side of the Himalayas. His words were always without any meaning.

sa: कमण्डलुश्चाप्यनु तं महर्षिगणसेवितः। तस्य दक्षिणतो भाति दण्डो गच्छन् श्रियो वृतः॥
en: And by the vessels and by the great Rishis. On the right looked beautiful the effulgent scepter followed by Bhrigu Angira and others.

sa: क्षेत्राद् वनाद् वा ग्रामाद् वा भर्तारं गृहमागतम्। अभ्युत्थायाभिनन्दामि आसनेनोदकेन च॥
en: Whether returning from the field, the forest or the town or hastily rising up I always salute my husband with water and seat.

sa: न ह्येवं शीलसम्पन्ना नैवं पूजितलक्षणाः। प्राप्नुवन्ति चिरं क्लेशं यथा त्वमसितेक्षणे॥
en: O black and beauty, women having such disposition and possessing such auspicious marks (as you have) can suffer misfortune for a long time.

sa: आमन्त्रणार्थं दूतांस्त्वं प्रेषयस्वाशुगान् द्रुतम्। उपश्रुत्य वचो राज्ञः स दूतान् प्राहिणोत् तदा॥ आमन्त्रयध्वं राष्ट्रेषु ब्राह्मणान् भूमिपानथ। विशश्च मान्यान् शूद्रांश्च सर्वानानयतेति च॥
en: “Dispatch soon (some-swift messengers to invite all. “Having heard the royal command, he (Sahadeva) soon sent messengers saying. “Invite all the Brahmanas of the kingdom, all the owners of land (Kshatriyas). All the Vaishyas, and all the respectable Shudras. Bring them all here (in this sacrifice)".

sa: ते वाचयित्वा पुण्याहमूहयित्वा च तं विधिम्। शास्त्रोक्तं पूजयामासुस्तद् देवयजनं महत्॥
en: Having uttered benedictions, and having recited the objects of the sacrifice, all of them worshipped the large (sacrificial) ground according to the ordinance.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्तः शकुनिना धृतराष्ट्रो जनेश्वरः। दुर्योधनं महामात्यमनुजज्ञे न कामतः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having been thus addressed by Shakuni, the ruler of earth, Dhritarashtra, unwillingly gave permission to Duryodhana and his counsellors togo.

sa: दुःशासनेन च तथा सौबलेन च धीमता। संवृतो भ्रातृभिश्चान्यैः स्त्रीभिश्चापि सहस्रशः॥
en: He has accompanied by Dushasana the intclligent son of Subala (Shakuni) and by many others of his brothers and also thousands of women.

sa: तत्रोपस्पृश्य राजेन्द्र पितृदेवार्चने रतः। नियतात्मा नरः पूतो गच्छेत परमां गतिम्॥
en: O king of kings, bathing there and worshipping the Pitris and the celestials with subdued soul, one being purified, obtains the highest state.

sa: ततो देवपथं गत्वा नियतो नियताशनः। देवसत्रस्य यत् पुण्यं तदेवाप्नोति मानवः॥
en: Then going to the Devapatha with regulated diet and subdued soul, a man obtains the merit that is the fruit of Deva sacrifice.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच भ्रातृणां मतमाज्ञाय नारदस्य चधीमतः। पितामहसमंधौम्यं प्राह राजा युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: Vaishampayana said: Having ascertained the opinion of his brothers and that of the intelligent Narada, Yudhishthira thus spoke to the grandfather like Dhaumya.

sa: यत्र कंचिद् वयं कालं वसन्तः सत्यविक्रमम्। प्रतीक्षामोऽर्जुनं वीरं वृष्टिकामा इवाम्बुदम्॥
en: And where we may pass some time waiting for the heroic and invincible Arjuna, as Chataka (bird) expects rain from the gathering clouds.

sa: सोऽतिविद्धो बलवता शत्रुणा शत्रुकर्शनः। जगाम परमं मोहं मोहयन् केशवं रणे॥
en: Thus sorely wounded by his powerful adversary, that subduer of the foes viz., Arjuna was overwhelmed with a swoon, confounding thereby Keshava himself.

sa: ते मया संक्रमा भग्नाः परिखाश्चावपूरिताः। दग्धा च नगरी लङ्का प्राकाराश्चावसादिताः॥
en: I have broken down the bridges and filled up the entrenchment. I have burnt that city of Lankā and laid the wall low.

sa: विव्याध चैनं बहुभिः सायकैर्नतपर्वभिः॥ अथान्यद् धनुरादाय सज्यं कृत्वा च सूतजः।
en: He then pierced him with many arrows of close knots. Then taking up another bow and stringing it, the son of the charioteer.

sa: विव्याध समरे भीमं भीमकर्मा महारथः॥ तस्य भीमो भृशं क्रुद्धस्त्रीशरान् नतपर्वणः।
en: That mighty car-warrior of dreadful deeds, pierced Bhima in battle (with many arrows). Thereat highly enraged, with three arrows of depressed knots, Bhima..

sa: भारद्वाजं च ते सर्वे न शेकुः प्रतिवीक्षितुम्। मध्यंदिनमनुप्राप्तं सहस्रांशुमिव प्रभो॥
en: They could not then behold the son of Bharadvaja, even as men cannot look at the midday sun of thousand rays, O lord.

sa: सा तथा पाण्डवी सेना पीड्यमाना महात्मन। निशि सम्प्राद्रवद् राजन्नुत्सृज्योल्काः सहस्रशः॥
en: Thus afflicted by that high-souled warrior, the Pandava army began to fly in all directions in that night, throwing down their blazing flambeaus.

sa: ऐरावतं समारूढो वृतः सर्वामरैः प्रभुः। नैव शक्रोऽपि समरे स्थितपूर्वः कदाचन॥
en: Not even that lord-Sakra himself-mounted on his Airāvata, and engirt by all the immortals, had ever before stayed before me in the field.

sa: ह्रियमाणे धने तस्मिन् ब्राह्मणः क्रोधमूर्च्छितः। आगम्य खाण्डवप्रस्थमुद क्रोशत् स पाण्डवान्॥
en: When his wealth (kine) was thus stolen, the Brahmana lost his senses in anger; and coming to Khandavaprastha, he thus reproved the Pandavas.

sa: तां विदार्य महासेनां शरैः संनतपर्वभिः। निश्चकाम रणाद् भीमो मत्स्यो जालादिवाम्भसि॥३७
en: As the fish frees itself from the net, so did Bhima cutting their shafts straight free himself from the pressure of the battle.

sa: आसाद्य भीमसेनं ते संरब्धा युद्धदुर्मदाः॥ विनेदुः सहसा दृष्ट्वा भूतग्रामा इवान्तकम्।
en: Indeed those warriors, stricken with fear and invincible in battle, approaching Bhimasena, suddenly died like living creatures at the look of the Destroyer.

sa: निशम्य पुत्रकान् बालान् माता तेषां तपस्विनी। जरिता शोकदुःखाती विललाप सुदुःखिता॥
en: Their ascetic mother Jarita, full of grief and sorrow, seeing that her sons were too young to escape, wept and lamented in grief.

sa: नैकान्तविजयो युद्धे भूतपूर्वः कदाचन। परैर्वा हन्यते वीरः परान्वा हन्ति संयुगे॥
en: Besides success in battle is not perpetual; either one slays his enemy or meets with his destruction at his hands in the conflict.

sa: मैवं शक्र पुनः कार्षीः शान्तो भवितुमर्हसि। त्वामप्येवंविधं ज्ञात्वा क्षिप्रमन्यं गमिष्यति॥
en: Do not, O Shakra, brag again! You should become tranquil! Knowing you to be full of vanity, she will very soon leave you.'

sa: तं स्मरन्तो वधं वीरा: सिन्धुराजस्य चाहवे। जयद्रथस्य कौरव्य समरे सव्यसाचिना॥ ततः पर्जन्यवत् सर्वे शरवृष्टीरवासृजन्। तै: कीर्णः शुशुभे पार्थो रविर्मेघान्तरे यथा॥
en: Recollecting the destruction by Dhananjaya of Jayadratha in battle, O you of Kuru's race, they poured heavy showers of arrows on that hero like a mass of clouds showering a heavy downpour. Overwhelmed with that arrow shower, Arjuna looked like the sun covered by a cloud.

sa: सौम्य राम निरीक्षस्व सौम्येन वदनेन माम्। कुबेरभवनात्प्राप्तं विद्धिमां पुष्पकं प्रभो॥
en: O gentle Rāma, do you with a delighted countenance behold me. O lord, know me as Puşpaka coming from the abode of Kuberu.

sa: अमी हि विविधैः पुष्पैस्तरवो विविधच्छदाः। काननेऽस्मिन् विना कान्तां चिन्तामुत्पादयन्ति मे॥
en: These trees, clothed in diverse flower attires, have been exciting my thought in this forest, who have been deprived of my dear one.

sa: त्रिशिखां भृकुटीं चास्य ददृशुः सर्वपार्थिवाः। भूयः ललाटस्थां त्रिकूटस्थां गङ्गां त्रिपथगामिव॥
en: The assembled kings saw on his forehead three lines of wrinkles like the Ganges with her three currents on the three peaked mountain.

sa: तस्य बाणमयं वर्ष जाम्बवत्याः सुतो महत्। मुमोच भरतश्रेष्ठ यथा वर्ष सहस्रदृक्॥ तद् बाणवर्षं तुमुलं विषेहे स चमूपतिः। क्षेमवृद्धिर्महाराज हिमवानिव निश्चलः॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, as Indra shower down rain, so did the son of Jambhavati (Samba) showers down arrows in a continuous stream. O great king, the commander of (Shalva's) forces, Kshemavriddhi, bore that shower of arrows (and stood) as immovable as the Himalayas.

sa: भवत्या यदभिप्रेतं तदहं कर्तुमागतः। शाधि मां धर्मतत्त्वज्ञे करवाणि प्रियं तव॥
en: "O mother, I have come to fulfill your wishes. Therefore, o virtuous lady, command me without delay. I shall accomplish what you desire.”

sa: एवमुक्त्वा ततो राजा सर्वसैन्येन भारत। अभ्यद्रवद् रणे द्रोणं युयुधानस्य कारणात्॥
en: Having thus spoken, the king, O Bharata, supported by all his troops, charged Drona in that battle, for the sake of rescuing Yuyudhana.

sa: स नियुक्तो मया व्यक्तं त्वया चाप्रतिमद्युतिः। भ्रातुः क्षेत्रेषु कल्याणमपत्यं जनयिष्यति॥
en: Asked by me and also by you, that Rishi of incomparable effulgence will surely beget excellent offspring on the wives of your brother.

sa: गृहाणि राजमार्गेषु रत्नवन्ति महान्ति च। प्राकम्पन्तेव भारेण स्त्रीणां पूर्णानि भारत॥
en: The large palaces that stood on the streetsides, gaily decked and full of ladies seemed to shake, O Bharata, with their fair denizens.

sa: दृष्ट्वा च विहतां मायां कर्णेन भरतर्षभ॥ घटोत्कचस्ततो मायां ससर्जन्तर्हितः पुनः।
en: Then, O foremost of the Bharatas, seeing his illusions nullified by Karna, Ghatotkacha once more put forth another illusion and rendered himself invisible.

sa: अवध्यो देवतानां यस्तथा दानवरक्षसाम्। हतः सोऽयं रणे शेते मानुषेण पदातिना॥
en: He whom the celestials, the Dānvas and the Rākşasa could not slay, has been slain in conflict by a man walking on foot.

sa: सुक्नयापि पतिं लब्ध्वा तपस्विनमनिन्दिता। नित्यं पर्यचरत् प्रीत्या तपसा नियमेन च॥
en: The faultless Sukanya also, having obtained that ascetic for her husband, began to wait upon him by practising asceticism and observing the ordinances,

sa: दीर्घमुष्णं श्वसन वीरो न किंचित् प्रत्यपद्यत। तस्मिंस्तु विवरे राजन् नाराचान् गार्धवाससः॥ प्राहिणोत् सूतपुत्राय भीमसेनश्चतुर्दश। ते तस्य कवचं भित्त्वा स्वर्णचित्रं महौजसः॥
en: The heroic Karna breathed hot and heavily and was embarrassed as to what he should do. At this opportunity O king, Bhimasena struck Suta's son with fourteen Narachas furnished with vulterine feathers. Those Narachas of great impetuosity and furnished with golden wings, pierced through Karna's armour;

sa: ततो युधिष्ठिरो राजा विललाप सुदुःखितः। अभिमन्यौ हते वीरे भ्रातुः पुत्रेमहारथे॥
en: Then upon the death of the brother's son, the heroic and mighty car-warrior Abhimanyu, king Yudhishthira began to lament totally unmanned by grief.

sa: रथिनामृषभं कर्णं धाराभिरिव तोयदः॥ शरवृष्टिं च तां कर्णो दूरात् प्राप्तामशातयत्।
en: That foremost car-warrior viz., Karna, like a could with showers of rain. But Karna repulsed that arrowy shower before it could reach him.

sa: तार्थ्य उवाच न हि त्वया सदृशी काचिदस्ति विभ्राजसे ह्यतिमात्रं यथा श्रीः। रूपं च ते दिव्यमनन्तकान्ति प्रज्ञां च देवीं सुभगे बिभर्षि॥
en: Tar enquired again O nice goddess! nobody here is worth comparison with you. You are perceived luminating like goddess Lakshmi. Your complexion with this supreme radiance is a divine one. You also hold the divine conscience concomitant to it. (I am curious to know its reason).

sa: स राजा चक्रवर्त्यासीत् सार्वभौमः प्रतापवान्। ईजे च बहुभिर्यज्ञैर्यथा शक्रो मरुत्पतिः॥
en: That king (Bharata) was known by the name of Chakravarti and Sarvabhauma. He performed many sacrifices like Indra, the lord of the Marutas.

sa: आयसी प्रतिमा येन भीमसेनस्य सा पुरा। चूर्णीकृता बलवता सोऽबलामाश्रितः स्त्रियम्॥
en: Alas, he by whom the iron image of Bhima on a former occasion was reduced to pieces, leans today on a weak woman.

sa: अहमप्युपवत्स्यामि यथैवायं गुरुर्मम। यदि राजा न भुङ्क्तेऽयं गान्धारी च यशस्विनी॥
en: I also shall fast even as my preceptor. Indeed, I shall fast if this king and Gandhari of great fame abstain from food.

sa: अस्याः कूले प्रमुदिताः सङ्घशः शकुनास्त्विह। दात्यूहरतिविक्रन्दैः पुंस्कोकिलरुतैरपि॥ स्वनन्ति पादपाश्चेमे ममानङ्गप्रदीपकाः।
en: There live happily flocks of delighted vultures. The trees sounded by the lascivious murmurs of Dätyűhas and Purnskokilas have been kindling my amour.

sa: ततो विज्ञातचरित: सत्कृत्य स विमोक्षितः। परिष्वक्तश्च सस्नेहं मृगेन्द्रेण पुनः पुनः॥
en: The jackal's innocence being proved, he was acquitted and respected by his master. The king of beasts embraced him affectionately again and again.

sa: श्रेयान् स्वधर्मो विगुणः परधर्मात् स्वनुष्ठितात्। स्वभावनियतं कर्म कुर्वन् नाप्नोति किल्बिषम्॥
en: Better is one's own duty, though performed imperfectly, than another's duty wellperformed. Man incurs no sin by performing his duty prescribed by Nature.

sa: शार्दूलस्तं तु गोमायुं स्नेहात् प्रोत्फुल्ललोचनः। अवारयत् स धर्मिष्ठ पूजया प्रतिपूजयन्॥
en: Looking upon the virtuous jackal with affection and honouring him with reverential worship, the tiger, tried to dissuade him from fulfilling his wishes.

sa: अनुज्ञातश्च रामेण मत्समोऽसीति भारत। कुण्डले रुचिरे चास्तां कर्णस्य सहजे शुभे॥
en: He has been told by Rama-you are equal to me, O Bharata. Two beautiful and blessed ear-rings Karna had from his very birth.

sa: गदामारुतवेगं हि दृष्ट्वा तस्य महात्मनः॥ भयं विवेश पाण्डूंस्तु सर्वानेव ससोमकान्।
en: Marking the vehemence of the wind, caused by the whirl of Duryodhana's mace, the Pandus and the Somakas were stricken with great fear.

sa: सहितास्तु नरव्याघ्रा हनिष्यन्ति धनंजयम्। भीष्मद्रोणकृपाणां च तुल्यः कर्णो मतो मम॥
en: And these tigers among men united together will kill Dhananjaya. Bhishma, Drona and Kripa together are equal to Karna, such is my opinion.

sa: राक्षसेनेरितं वाक्यं त्रासात् त्राहीति शोभने। न भवत्या व्यथा कार्या कुनारीजनसेविता॥
en: O beauteous lady, these words, save memust have been uttered by some Rākşasa from fear. You should not act like a mean woman.

sa: तदत्र कार्यनिर्बन्धे समुत्पन्ने दुरासदे। किं पश्यसि समाधानं त्वं हि कार्यविशारदः॥
en: Then in this business at hand hard to accomplish, what means do you, versed in business, see, whereby the end may be attained?

sa: तपन्त्यन्ये दहन्त्यन्ये गर्जन्त्यन्ये तथा घनाः। विद्योतन्ते प्रवर्षन्ति तव प्रावृषिः रश्मयः॥
en: Your rays are warm and they scorch (things). Becoming clouds they roar and flash lightning; they pour down showers when the scason comes.

sa: तव यादयो न स्यादन्धं जगदिदं भवेत्। न चधर्मार्थकामेषु प्रवर्तेरन् मनीषिणः॥
en: If you do not rise, the universe becomes blind. The learned men cannot employ themselves in the attainment of Dharma, Artha and Kama.

sa: एकोऽपसृत्य चेदिभ्यः पाण्डवान् य: समाश्रितः। धृष्टकेतुं समायान्तं द्रोणं कस्तं न्यवारयत्॥
en: That one who alone descrting the Chedis had sided with the Pandus, namely Dhristaketu, what heroes surrounded him when he advanced towards Drona?

sa: संजय उवाच इत्युको धर्मराजेन तथेत्युक्त्वा धनंजयः। व्यादिदेश स्वसैन्यानि स्वयं चागाचमूमुखम्॥
en: Sanjaya said Thus addressed by the pious Yudhishthira, Dhananjaya said-'so be it' and ordered his army. He then himself proceeded to the head.

sa: आरावं विपुलं कुर्वन् व्यथयन् सर्वसैनिकान्। यदाऽऽयान्नकुलो द्रोणं के शूराः पर्यवारयन्॥
en: When that Nakula giving forth a loud roar and afflicting the whole army, rushed upon Drona, what warriors tried to check his career?

sa: ततः स पुरुषव्याघ्रस्तामादाय शुचिस्मिताम्। रथेन काञ्चना न प्रययौ स्वपुरं प्रति॥
en: Thereupon that best of men, having seized that lady of sweet-smiles, proceeded (in haste) on his golden car towards his own city (Indraprastha).

sa: भुक्तवत्सु च विप्रेषु भोजयित्वानुजानपि। शेषं विघससंज्ञं तु पश्चाद् भुङ्क्ते युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: After the Brahmanas had been fed and his younger brothers also, Yudhishthira himself ate the food that remained and which was called Vighasa.

sa: तरसैवाभिपद्याथ यो वै द्रोणमुपाद्रवत्। यः करोति महत् कर्म शत्रूणां वै महाबलः॥ महाकायो महोत्साहो नागायुतसमो बले। तं भीमसेनमायान्तं के शूराः पर्यवारयन्॥
en: That hero who rushing with headlong speed charged Drona, who achieves grand feats at the expense of the enemy, that most puissant one of gigantic stature and great vigour, who equals ten thousand elephants in strength, what warrior surrounded that Bhimasena as he charged my army?

sa: राजानमद्य भवतां न्यासभूतं ददानि वै। तस्य संरक्षणे सर्वे यतध्वं विगतज्वराः॥
en: Today I made over the king to you as a sacred trust; do you all, shaking off lethargy, address yourselves to protect him."

sa: अनुमानात् तु जानामि मैथिली सा न संशयः। ह्रियमाणा मया दृष्टा रक्षसा रौद्रकर्मणा॥ क्रोशन्ती रामरामेति लक्ष्मणेति च विस्वरम्। स्फुरन्ती रावणस्याङ्के पन्नगेन्द्रवधूर्यथा॥
en: From guess I find that it was doubtless Mithilā's daughter whom I saw when she was being carried away by that Räksa of terrific deeds. She was crying, Rama, Laksmana, Laks maņa,' and in the lap of Răvaņa she looked like the wife of the Snake-chief.

sa: अस्ति सीमन्तिनी काचिद् दृष्टपूर्वापि वा श्रुता। पतिव्रता महाभागा यथेयं दुपदात्मजा॥
en: Have you ever seen or heard of a lady as highly fortunate and as devoted to her husband as the daughter of Dripada?

sa: तं शैलमिव शैलाभाः सर्वे तु प्लवगर्षभाः। समारुह्य समुत्पत्य ददंशुः प्लवगर्षभाः।३१॥
en: Ascending a mountain-summit, those foremost of monkeys, possessed of the splendour of a mountain-peak, sprang upon him and tore him with their teeth.

sa: ततो विदुरवाक्येन नावं विक्षिप्य पाण्डवाः। धनं चादाय तैर्दत्तमरिष्टं प्राविशन् वनम्॥
en: Then leaving the boat according to the advice of Vidura, the Pandavas entered a forest taking the wealth that was given to them.

sa: श्रुतकीर्तिस्तथा वीरो जयत्सेनं सुतं तव। अभ्ययात् समरे राजन् हन्तुकामो यशस्विनम्॥
en: Thereafter, 0 monarch, Shrutakirti possessed of heroism, rushed, in that battle, against your illustrious son Jayatsena, out of a desire for slaying him.

sa: न हि धर्मं परं जातु नावबुध्येत पार्थिवः। भीष्मः शान्तनवस्त्वेनं मावमंस्थास्त्वमन्यथा॥
en: O king, do not insult the son of Shantanu, Bhishma, by erroneously thinking that he does not know what is the great Dharma.

sa: इमानि च महार्हाणि वस्त्राण्याभरणानि च। प्रतिगृह्य विशालाक्ष मातुलस्य च दापय॥
en: And, O you of expansive eyes, do you take these costly raiment's and ornaments, and present them to your maternal uncle and grandfather.

sa: एतावेव हि संक्रुद्धौ सवाजिरथकुञ्जराम्॥ लङ्कां नाशयितुं शक्तौ सर्वे तिष्ठन्तु वानराः।
en: And these two, if worked up with ire, are capable of destroying the whole city of Lankā with her horses, chariots and elephants.

sa: प्रविष्टे तव सैन्यं त शैनेय सत्यविक्रमे। भीमसेनमुखाः पार्थाः प्रतीयुर्वाहिनीं तव॥
en: When Sini's grandson of invincible prowess had entered into your troops, the troops of the Parthas headed by Bhimasena, fell upon your troops.

sa: यथोद्वत्तं वारयते वेला वै सलिलार्णवम्। पाण्डुसैन्यं तथा संख्ये हार्दिक्यः समवारयत्॥
en: Just as the banks resist the surging waves of the sea, so did the son of Hridika resist the Pandava troops in battle.

sa: पार्थिवाः पृथिवीपाला यस्यासन् वशवर्तिनः। स वशे विवशो राजा परेषामद्य वर्तते॥
en: Alas! even that king, who had all the kings of earth in subjection, has lost his liberty and lives in subjection to others.

sa: इन्द्रप्रस्थे निवसतः समये यस्य पार्थिवाः। आसन् बलिभृतः सर्वे सोऽद्यान्यै तिमिच्छति॥
en: Alas! even he begs for his subsistence at another's hands whom residing at Indraprastha, all the kings of earth used to pay tributes.

sa: तथा त्वमपि कौन्तेय ब्राह्मणान् सततं प्रभो॥ पूजयस्व महाभागान् वाग्भिर्दानैश्च नित्यदा।
en: Do you also, O son of Kunti, adore the highly blessed Brahmanas every day with gifts of wealth and kind, O powerful one.

sa: प्रियकामश्च ते मातुस्दर्थं चास्य जीवितम्। तस्यापत्यं च नास्त्यन्यत् तस्मादङ्गद गम्यताम्॥
en: He loves your mother, and his life is for her; and she has no other son. Therefore, O Angada, go along with us.

sa: विव्याध पाण्डवान् युद्धे त्रिभिस्त्रिभिरजिह्मगैः। शिखण्डिनं च विव्याध त्रिभिः पञ्चभिरेव च॥
en: Pierced the Pandavas in battle, each with three straight-flying arrows. He then pierced Sikhandin at first with three and then with five arrows.

sa: भवतेऽहं ददानीदं भवानेतत् प्रयच्छतु। रुचितो वर्तते धर्मो न बलात् सम्प्रवर्तते॥
en: I give you this. Give me this other thing in exchange. Such an exchange is righteous. To take things by force, is sinful.

sa: अकस्माच्च प्रहसति तथाकस्मात् प्ररोदिति। न चास्य वयसा तुल्यः पृथिव्यामभवत् तदा॥
en: He would sometimes laugh without any reason and sometimes cry uselessly At that time there was nobody on Earth a old as he.

sa: मङ्गल्यान् पक्षिणश्चैव यच्चान्यदपि पूजितम्। दृष्ट्वास्पृष्ट्वा च कौन्तेयो बाह्यां कक्ष्यां ततोऽगमत्।।
en: And auspicious birds and other things considered to be holy-seeing and touching these things, the son of Kunti proceeded to the outer apartments.

sa: एक एव च बीभत्सुः प्रविष्टस्तात भारतीम्। अविषह्यां महाबाहुः सुरैरपि महाहवे॥
en: O sire, single-handed has the mighty-armed Vibhatsu entered into the Bharata army which cannot be encountered even by the celestials themselves in battle.

sa: ततः काले बहुतिथे कस्मिंश्चित् सुमनोहरे। वसन्ते समनुप्राप्ते राज्ञो यष्टुं मनोऽभवत्॥
en: Then after a long while, when the charming spring had appeared on the earth, the king conceived the desire of celebrating the sacrifice.

sa: राक्षसानामिदं वत्स सुराणामथवापि वा। तरुणादित्यसंकाशं वैदूर्यगुलिकाचितम्॥ विशीर्णं पतितं भूभौ कवचं कस्य काञ्चनम्। छत्रं शतशलाकं च दिव्यमाल्योपशोभितम्॥ भग्नदण्डमिदं सौम्य भूमौ कस्य निपातितम्। काञ्चनोरश्छदाश्चेमे पिशाचवदनाः खराः॥ भीमरूपा महाकायाः कस्य वा निहता रणे।
en: O brother, this belongs either to the celestials or to the Rākşasas. Whose is this golden armour lying shattered on earth, resembling the newly risen sun, in colour and adorned with sapphire? Whose is this umbrella lying broken on earth, containing a hundred rod and adorned with celestial garlands? In whose conflict have these terrible asses, of large proportions, having faces of demon and with breast plates, been killed?

sa: ताभिः स बलवान् नादः क्रोशन्तीभिरनुद्रुतः। येन स्फीतीकृतो भूयस्तद् गृहं समनादयत्॥
en: And the loud sounds emitted by these, mingling with those (who had been lamenting before them), attained greater proportions and filled the hall.

sa: एकाहार्यं युगं सर्वं लोभमोहव्यवस्थितम्। अधर्मो वर्द्धते तत्र न तुधर्मः प्रवर्तते॥
en: Full of avarice and ignorance all the world will have but one sort of food, sin will increase and virtue will fade away.

sa: पञ्चमे वाथ षष्ठे वा वर्षे कन्या प्रसूयते। सप्तपवर्षाष्टवर्षाश्च प्रजास्यन्ति नरास्तदा॥
en: Girls of five and six years will give birth to children and boys of seven or eight years of age will be fathers.

sa: न तत् सोहृदमन्येषु मया शैनेय लक्षितम्। यथा त्वमस्मान् भजसे वर्तमानानुपप्लवे॥
en: When at Upaplava, O grandson of Sini, I did not mark any one else who showed us greater love and affection, than yourself.

sa: एतदिच्छाम्यहं श्रोतुं कुशलो ह्यासि भाषितुम्। असा तमहं मन्ये तन्ममाचक्ष्व संजय॥
en: I am desirous of listening to all this. You are a skillful narrator. I regard him invincible. O Sanjaya, relate to me this.

sa: यो ह्ययं मम लाङ्गुले दीप्यते हव्यवाहनः। अस्य संतर्पणं न्याय्यं कर्तुमेभिर्गृहोत्तमैः॥
en: That bearer of sacrificial offerings (Vide ante) who flame on my tail, it is my duty to propitiate him with these excellent edifices.

sa: अथैनं छिन्नधन्वानं नवभिर्निशितैः शरैः। विव्याध हृदये तूर्णं तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति चाब्रवीत्॥
en: Then he quickly pierced that (warrior) whose bow was cut-off, in the chest, with nine sharpened arrows and said (to him) “wait, wait."

sa: मया च प्रत्यभिज्ञाता वंशस्य परिकीर्तनात्। अस्य दुःखस्य चोत्पत्तिं भीष्ममेवेह मन्यते॥
en: She was recognized by me owing to her describing her parentage and she thinks Bhishma as the origin of this calamity of hers.

sa: किंचित् कालमिदं देवा मर्षयध्वमतन्द्रिताः। श्रुत्वा विष्णोः शुभां सत्यां वाणी ताममृतोपमाम्॥
en: For some time, O gods, must you be patient and watchful." Hearing these words of Vishnu which were true, auspicious and like nectar.

sa: सेनावशेषं तं दृष्ट्वा तव पुत्रस्य पाण्डवः। अवस्थितं सव्यसाची चुक्रोध बलावन्नृप॥
en: Then the mighty Savyasachin, the son of Pandu, beholding the remaining portion of your army still fighting was filled with anger, O king.

sa: स वध्यमानः समरे शैनेयस्य शरोत्तमैः। प्राद्रवत् सहसा राजन् पुत्रो दुर्योधनस्तव॥
en: Thus pierced by the excellent shafts of the grandson of Sini, Oking, your son Duryodhana suddenly fled away from the field of battle.

sa: प्रमद्वरायां तु रुरोः पुत्रः समुदपद्यत। शुनको नाम विप्रर्षिर्यस्य पुत्रोऽथ शौनकः॥
en: Ruru begot a son upon his wife Pramadvara. That son was the regenerate Rishi Shunaka. Shunaka begot a son who is named Shaunaka.

sa: राम उवाच किमर्थं कुरूणां कृष्टं क्षेत्रमेतन्महात्मना। एतदिच्छाम्यहं श्रोतुं कथ्यमानं तपोधनाः॥
en: Rama said “Why did the great Kuru cultivated this field? I desire to have this described by you, you Rishis of great penances."

sa: तावर्जुनं सहस्रेण पत्रिणां नतपर्वणाम् । पूरयामासतुः क्रुद्धौ तटागं जलदौ यथा॥
en: Inflamed with rage, they covered Arjuna with a thousand winged shafts of depressed knots, like clouds filling a lake with torrents of rain.

sa: ततो रामं स्थितं दृष्ट्वा लक्ष्मणं च महाबलम्। सुग्रीवः सर्वतश्चक्षुर्वने लोलमपातयत्॥
en: The next day seeing Rāma as well as the mighty Lakşmaņa seated on the ground, Sugrīva briskly cast his eyes about the forest.

sa: ततो धनंजयो राजन् रथानीकमगाहत। विश्रुतं त्रिषु लोकेषु गाण्डीवं व्याक्षिपन् धनुः॥
en: Then Dhananjaya, O king, penetrated into the midst of the car-detachment of the Kauravas, expanding his bow Gandiva known over the three worlds.

sa: क्व यास्यसे महाराज हित्वेमं दु:खितं जनम्। हीनं पुरुषसिंहेन रामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा ॥
en: Whither wend you, O mighty monarch, forsaking these aggrieved people, who have already been deprived of the lion like Rāma energetic in action?

sa: भक्तिमन्तीह भूतानि जङ्गमाजङ्गमानि च। याचमानेषु तेषु त्वं भक्तिं भक्तेषु दर्शय॥
en: All creatures mobile and immobile cherish you with high regard. All these beseech you. Do you show consideration to those that regard you.

sa: यं यान्तमनुयाति स्म चतुरङ्गबलं महत्। तमेकं सीतया सार्धमनुयाति स्म लक्ष्मणः॥
en: He that used to be followed by the vast body of the four-fold forces, proceeds now along with Sita, followed by Laksmana alone.

sa: सा सपुत्रापियं श्रुत्वा वधं भर्तुः सुदारुणम्। निष्पपात भृशं तस्मादुद्विग्ना गिरिकन्दरात्॥
en: Hearing the heart-rending news of her husband's demise, she, big with a child, issued out of the mountain cave with a troubled heart.

sa: तथा कोसलराजानं भानुमन्तं सुसत्कृतम्। मगधाधिपति शूरं सर्वशास्त्रविशारदम्॥ प्राप्तिज्ञं परमोदारं सत्कृतं पुरुषर्षभम्। राज्ञः शासनमादाय चोदयस्व नृपर्षभान्। प्राचीनान् सिन्धुसौवीरान्सौराष्ट्रेयांश्च पार्थिवान्॥ दाक्षिणात्यान् नरेन्द्रांश्च समस्तानानयस्व ह। सन्ति स्निग्धाश्च ये चान्ये राजानः पृथिवीतले ॥ तानानय यथा क्षिप्रं सानुगान् सहबान्धवान्। एतान् दूतैर्महाभागैरानयस्व नृपाज्ञया॥
en: Also bring with due respect the puissant king of Kosala. The heroic, and highly generous lord of Magadha, versed in all branches of learning. And in accordance with the mandate of the king, do invite the foremost monarchs! And summon the king, of the East, of the Sindhu and Sauvīra countries, and of Saurastra, and of the South! And speedily bring those monarchs that are attached to us, together with their friends and followers, the mandate of the monarch, bring over these, despatching dignified emissaries.

sa: महर्षिसेवितः पुण्यः एकान्ते पश्य भगवन्नाश्रमस्थानमुत्तमम्। रमते यत्र वैदेही सुखार्दा जनकात्मजा॥
en: Do you, O worshipful one, hit upon a retired and agreeable asylum where Janaka's daughter worthy of happiness, will pass her days pleasantly.

sa: तं वर्धयित्वा राजानं पूर्वं सूतो जयाशिषा। भयविक्लवया वाचा मन्दया श्लक्ष्णयाब्रवीत्॥
en: And first paying homage to the king, invoking victory upon him, the charioteer, perplexed with fear, softly and sweetly addressed the monarch thus:

sa: एष धर्मश्च सुश्रोणि पितुर्मातुश्च वश्यता। आज्ञां चाहं व्यतिक्रम्य नाहं जीवितुमुत्सहे॥
en: Obedience to his parents is the virtue of a son. Disobeying the command of my father I am not eager to live. we

sa: ततः परमसत्कारं सुमतेः प्राप्य राघवौ। उष्य तत्र निशामेकां जग्मतुर्मिथिलां ततः।।।।
en: Meeting with such splendid reception from Sumati, those descendants of Raghu spent there a night, and the next day set out for Mithila.

sa: ततः सोमाश्रमं गत्वा देवगन्धर्वसेवितम्। कालं नाम महासानुं पर्वतं तं गमिष्यथ॥
en: Then, coming upon the hermitage of Soma, frequented by gods and Gandharvas, do you repair to the mountain called kāla possessing spacious plateaus,

sa: तत्तु शीघ्रमतिक्रम्य कान्तारं रोमहर्षणम्। कैलासं पाण्डुरं प्राप्य हृष्टा यूयं भविष्यथ॥
en: Speedily passing that desert land capable of making one's hair stand on end, you shall feel delighted, on coming to the pale Kailasa.

sa: अर्थितो ह्यस्मि कैकेय्या वनं गच्छेति राघव। मया चोक्तं व्रजामीति तत्सत्यमनुपालये॥
en: Directed by Kaikeyi saying, 'Do you, O Rāghava, go to the forest,' I had said, 'I will go,', That promise I must accomplish.

sa: कामार्तश्च महाराजः पिता दशरथः स्वयम्॥ कैकेय्याः प्रियकामार्थं तं रामं नाभ्यषेचयत्।
en: Our father the king Daśaratha was entirely under the control of passions, and hence for the satisfaction of Kaikeyi did not install Rāma.-

sa: दद्यान्न प्रतिगृह्णीयात् सत्यं ब्रूयान्न चानृतम्॥ एतद् ब्राह्मण रामस्य व्रतं धृतमनुत्तमम्।
en: He always maketh gifts and taketh none. He always speaketh truth and never telleth an untruth. This is his best observance O Brāhmana.

sa: दर्शनार्थं तु वैदेह्याः सर्वतः कपिकुञ्जराः। व्यादिष्टाः कपिराजेन यथोक्तं जग्मुरञ्जसा ॥
en: The principal monkeys, having been ordered by the monkey-king, speedily went in all directions to their destinations for the purpose of seeing Vaidehi.

sa: पिता हि दैवतं तात देवतानामपि स्मृतम्। तस्माद् दैवतमित्येव करिष्यामि पितुर्वचः॥
en: The father is a very God, even the celestials say this. Therefore will I look upon your word in the light of divinity.

sa: तात राजा दशरथः स्वर्गतो धर्ममाचरन्। धनधान्यवतीं स्फीतां प्रदाय पृथिवीं तव॥
en: Your child, leaving to you this prosperous carth abounding in corn and wealth, king Dasaratha having performed his duties, has gone to heaven.

sa: आश्चर्यमिव पश्यामि यस्यास्ते वृत्तमीदृशम्। आचरन्त्या न विदृता सद्यो भवति मेदिनी॥
en: A wonder it is that I perceive, viz., that the carth hid by a character like you is not riven this very day.

sa: ततः सुमन्त्रस्त्वरितं गत्वा त्वरितविक्रमः। समानयत् स तान् सर्वान् समस्तान् वेदपारगान्॥
en: Thereupon, going out speeding, Sumantra of swift movements called together all the spiritual guides, as well as others versed in the Vedic ritual.

sa: असर्पत जलं तत्र तीव्रशब्दपुरस्कृतम्। मत्स्यकच्छपसबैश्च शिंशुमारगणैस्तथा॥ पतद्भिः पतितैश्चैव व्यरोचत वसुंधरा।
en: And there her waters flowed with thundering sounds. And earth looked beautiful with swarms of fallen and falling fishes, and tortoises, and porpoises.

sa: यदि मे याचमानस्य त्यागमेव करिष्यसि। सरथोऽग्नि प्रवेक्ष्यामि त्यक्तमात्र इह त्वया॥
en: But if you forsake me who beseech you, I will as soon as left by you, enter into fire along with the car.

sa: उपागम्य च मे देवो महादेवः सुरेश्वरः। सर्वांल्लोकाञ्जितानाह मम पुण्येन कर्मणा॥
en: Coming to me, that mighty deity, the Sovereign of the celestials, said that I had acquired all the worlds by my pious acts.

sa: अस्यां त्वहमवस्थायां वीर वक्ष्यामि यद् वचः। यद्यप्यसुकरं राजन् कर्तुमेव त्वमर्हसि।७।।
en: It behoveth you, O hero, O king, to perform what I shall speak to you in this plight, however difficult it might be.

sa: उद्योगसमयस्त्वेष प्राप्तः शत्रुनिषूदन ॥ संचिन्यतां हि पिङ्गेश हरिभिः सह मन्त्रिभिः।
en: O destroyer of foes, the time is come for exertion: do you, O lord of monkeys, bethink yourself along with your monkey ministers.

sa: अश्रुत्वा राजवचनं कथं गच्छामि भामिनि। तच्छ्रुत्वा मन्त्रिणो वाक्यं राजा मन्त्रिणमब्रवीत्॥
en: “How can I go," replied Sumantra, Without the permission of the king?” Hearing these words of the counsellor, the king spoke to him.

sa: सा त्वं वसेह कल्याणि राज्ञः समनुवर्तिनी। भरतस्य रता धर्मे सत्यव्रतपरायणा॥
en: It therefore behoves you, Oh auspicious one, to live here, abiding by Bharata's commands and being engaged in religious rites and truthful vows.

sa: सर्वप्रजाभिरामं हि रामं प्रव्रज्य धार्मिकम्। सर्वलोकविरोधेन कथं राजा भविष्यति ॥
en: How by banishing the righteous Rāma dear to all the subjects, and thus withstanding the wishes of all, will he retain his royalty?

sa: आदाय शिबिकां तारः स तु पर्यापतत् पुनः। वानरैरुह्यमानां तां शूरैरुद्वनोचितैः॥
en: And taking that conveyance carried by the monkeys and worthy of being carried by the heroes, he issued out again of the cave.

sa: गङ्गा हिमवतो ज्येष्ठा दुहिता पुरुषर्षभ। तस्यां कुरु महाबाहो पितृणां सलिलक्रियाम्॥
en: Gangā, O foremost of men, is the elder daughter of Himavat. In her (streams) do you perform the watery rites of your uncles,

sa: स भग्नधन्वा विरथो हताश्वो हतसारथिः। अङ्केनादाय वैदेहीं पपात भुवि रावणः॥
en: Having his bow snapped and deprived of his car, horses and charioteer, Rāvana fell down to the earth, taking Vaidehi on his lap.

sa: देव राजरथं दृष्ट्वा विना राममिहागतम्। दूरादश्रुमुखः सर्वो राजमार्गे गतो जनः॥
en: And, O revered one, seeing the royal car returned hither without Rāma, the people on the highways from grief appear with tearful countenance.

sa: अपिधाय बिलद्वारं शैलशृङ्गेण तत् तदा॥ तस्माद् देशादपाक्रम्य किष्किन्धां प्राविशं पुनः।
en: Then closing up the mouth of the cavern with a mountain summit, and returning from that place, I again came back to Kiskindhā.

sa: निःसाध्वसमिदं प्रोक्तं धर्मादपि विगर्हितम्। अतिक्रम्य तु मद्वाक्यं दारुणं रोमहर्षणम्॥ श्वमांसभोजिनः सर्वे वासिष्ठा इव जातिषु । पूर्णं वर्षसहस्रं तु पृथिव्यामनुवत्स्यथ ॥
en: Disregarding my words, you have uttered this audacious and shocking speech, disclaimed by morality, and capable of causing one's hair to stand on end. Therefore, becoming Mustikas, and living on dogs' flesh, do you all, even like Vasiştha's sons, inhabit the earth for a thousand years.

sa: तस्य तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा सर्वानेव दिशागजान्। यथाक्रमं यथान्यायं प्रष्टुं समुपचक्रमे॥
en: And hearing those words of his, Ansumat by turns duly asked the same question of all the elephants belonging to the cardinal points.

sa: राक्षसैर्धर्षितानां च तापसानां तपस्विनाम्॥ गतिं मृगयमाणानां भवान् नः परमा गतिः।
en: Of the saints and ascetics afflicted by the Rākşasas, who are on the search for their refuge, you are our best refuge. sore

sa: राघवस्य कुले जातैरुदधिः परिवर्धितः॥ स त्वां रामहिते युक्तं प्रत्यर्चयति सागरः।
en: This ocean was reared by one born in the family of Raghus. And beholding you engaged on Rāma's behoof he is worshipping you.

sa: भवितव्यतया नूनमिदं वा व्यसनं महत्। कुलस्यास्य विनाशाय प्राप्तं सूत यदृच्छया॥
en: Meseems, O charioteer, for the purpose of destroying this line entirely, this mighty disaster has surely befallen us through the influence of Destiny.

sa: त्राहि मामद्य काकुत्स्थ लक्ष्मणेति वराङ्गना। सुसंत्रस्ता समाक्रन्दच्छृण्वतां तु यथान्तिके ॥
en: O Kākutstha, O Laksmana, save me! Thus did that best of females, afflicted with fear, bewail; and those near (her) heard her lamentations.

sa: तस्य भूमौ शयानस्य पादौ प्रक्षाल्य लक्ष्मणः। सभार्यस्य ततोऽभ्येत्य तस्थौ वृक्षमुपाश्रितः॥
en: On Rāma having lain down on the ground along with his wife, Lakşmaņa washed their feet, and then remained stationed under the tree.

sa: प्रसन्नसलिले रम्ये तस्मिन् सरसि शुश्रुवे।। गीतवादिनिर्घोषो न तु कश्चन दृश्यते॥
en: And in that tank containing charming and pleasant waters, they heard sounds of song and instrumental music; but no one was seen there.

sa: स मामुपगतः क्रुद्धो वज्रमुद्यम्य देवराट्। ततोऽहं सहसा क्षिप्तः श्वसनेन महात्मना॥
en: When with his thunderbolt, the Lord of celestials, wroth, approached me, I was all on a sudden thrown down by the high-souled Wind.

sa: स रामो बहुभिर्बाणैः खरकार्मुकनिः सृतैः। विद्धो रुधिरनिक्ताङ्गो बभूव रुषितो भृशम्॥
en: Rāma on being pierced with a good many shafts discharged from Khara's bow, and having his body bathed in blood, was highly wroth.

sa: स शरैरर्पितः क्रुद्धः सर्वगात्रेषु राघवः। रराज समरे रामो विधूमोऽग्रिरिव ज्वलन्॥
en: And pierced with those arrow, all over his body, and inflamed with rage, Rāghava appeared in the field, like a smokeless flaming fire.

sa: दण्ड्ये यः पातयेद् दण्डं दण्ड्यो यश्चापि दण्ड्यते। कार्यकारणसिद्धार्थावुभौ तौ नावसीदतः॥ तद् भवान् दण्डसंयोगादस्माद् विगतकल्मषः। गतः स्वां प्रकृतिं धम्यां दण्डदिष्टेन वर्त्मना॥
en: They never lose their virtue being proficient in the mode of ascerting crime and punishing it one administering punishment to the criminal and the criminal receiving it. And therefore receiving punishment (from me) you had been released from your sins and acquired a knowledge of religion.

sa: स गत्वा दूरमध्वानं सम्परिश्रान्तवाहनः। उवाच वचनं श्रीमान् वसिष्ठं मन्त्रिणां वरम्॥
en: And having proceeded a long way, the graceful Bharata, with his bearers extremely tired, said these words to that foremost of counsellors, Vasistha.

sa: सोऽभिषेकं ततः कृत्वा तीर्थे तस्मिन् यथाविधि। तमेव चिन्तयत्रर्थमुपावर्तत वै मुनिः॥
en: Then having duly performed his ablutions at that holy spot, the reverend sage retraced his steps, pondering over the incidents touching the sloka.

sa: ततस्तद् विलमासाद्य सुगन्धि दुरतिक्रमम्॥ विस्मयव्यग्रमनसो बभूवुर्वानरर्षभाः। संजातपरिशङ्कास्ते तद् बिलं प्लवगोत्तमाः॥
en: And drawing nigh to that fragrant and inaccessible cave, those superior monkeys were struck with amaze, and became eager (to enter into it).

sa: ततो हलहलाशब्दो यज्ञे रामस्य पृष्ठतः। नराणां प्रेक्ष्य राजानं सीदन्तं भृशदुःखितम्॥
en: Then seeing the sovereign senseless and stricken with exceeding sorrow, the multitudes at the rear of Rāma broke out into a loud tumult.

sa: ज्यां विधुन्वन् सुबहुशः शिक्षयास्त्राणि दर्शयन्। चचार समरे मार्गाशरैरथ गतः खरः॥
en: Repeatedly twanging his twanging his bow, Khara, mounted on his car, began to range the field, displaying his weapons through his acquired skill.

sa: खमुत्पतन्तं तं दृष्ट्वा मैथिली जनकात्मजा। दुःखिता परमोद्विग्ना भये महति वर्तिनी॥
en: Seeing him fly up into the air, Janaka's daughter, Maithili, became aggrieved and exceedingly agitated, and great was the fear that possessed her.

sa: अशोभत मुखं तस्य जृम्भमाणस्य धीमतः। अम्बरीषोपमं दीप्तं विधूम इव पावकः॥
en: The face of him, as that intelligent one was filling, himself has force was aflame like a frying-pan, or like to themeless fire.

sa: अथ नात्र नरव्याघ्रौ राजपुत्रौ परंतपौ। अन्ये रामोपमाः सन्ति व्यक्तमत्र तपस्विनः॥
en: But if those foremost of men, those subduers of their enemies, the princes, be not here, there are others, being ascetics, resembling Rāma.

sa: कच्चिन्मुख्या महत्स्वेव मध्यमेषु च मध्यमा। जघन्याश्च जघन्येषु भृत्यास्ते तात योजिताः॥
en: And, my child, do you employ the best servants upon the best offices, the middling upon middling, and the worst upon the worst?

sa: यस्येयं वसुधा कृत्स्ना वासुदेवस्य धीमतः। महिषी माधवस्यैषा स एव भगवान् प्रभुः॥ कापिलं रूपमास्थाय धारयत्यनिशं धराम्। तस्य कोपाग्निना दग्धा भविष्यन्ति नृपात्मजाः॥
en: This entire Earth belong to the intelligent Vasudeva, she being his consort. And that adorable one is indeed her lord. And assuming the form of Kapila, he unceasingly sustain the Earth. And the sons of king Sagara will be consumed by the fire of his wrath.

sa: वेगिनी च कुलिङ्गाख्यां ह्रादिनी पर्वतावृताम्। यमुनां प्राप्य संतीर्णो बलमाश्वासयत् तदा॥
en: Next crossing the rapid river Kulingā and the Hrādinſ surrounded by hills, as well as the Yamunā, he ordered the forces to halt.

sa: भित्त्वेव वसुधा भाति चित्रकूटः समुत्थितः। चित्रकूटस्य कूटोऽयं दृश्यते सर्वतः शुभः॥
en: And Citrakuța looks as if it had arisen, riving the earth; and the fair front of Citrakuța can be perceived from every point.

sa: स च पम्पामतिक्रम्य लङ्कामभिमुखः पुरीम्॥ जगाम मैथिली गृह्य रुदतीं राक्षसेश्वरः।
en: The lord of Rākşasas, passing beyond Pampā, directed his course towards the city of Lankā, taking Mithilā's daughter along with him, indulging lamentations.

sa: बहुशो हि मया दृष्टः सागरे स महाबलः। भुजङ्गानुद्धरन् पक्षी महाबाहुर्महाबलः॥
en: Many a time and oft. I have see that exceedingly powerful, mighty-armed one, endowed with strength of will,-raise up serpents in the ocean.

sa: स तत् प्रहर्षमलभद् विपुलं पर्वतोत्तमः। देवतानां पतिं दृष्ट्वा परितुष्टं शतक्रतुम्॥
en: Beholding that lord of celestials the performer of an hundred sacrifices, highly gratified, that best of mountains attained to an excess of joy.

sa: पञ्च सेनाग्रगान् हत्वा सप्त मन्त्रिसुतानपि। शूरमक्षं च निक्षिप्य ग्रहणं समुपागमत्॥
en: Then having slain five generals, and seven counsellors' sons, and crushed the heroic Aksa, he was bound fast (by the arms of Indrajit.)

sa: अतो दु:खतरं लोके न किञ्चित् प्रतिभाति मे। यत्र रामः पितुर्दद्यादिगुदीक्षोदमृद्धिमान्॥
en: Nothing appears to me more deplorable in this world than this that the auspicious Rāma has offered an Ingudi cake to his father.

sa: तमुवाच महातेजा विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः॥ श्रूयतां वत्स काकुत्स्थ यस्यैतद् दारुणं वनम्।
en: Him answered thus the mighty ascetic Viśvāmitra endowed with high energy, Do you listen, O Kākutstha, as to whom belong this dreadful forest!

sa: पीठे कार्णायसे चैव निषण्णं कृष्णवाससम्। प्रहरन्ति स्म राजानं प्रमदाः कृष्णपिङ्गलाः॥
en: I saw the king seated on a sable seat of iron, clad in a sable garb; and women black and yellow beating him.

sa: तदेभिः कारणैः सर्वैर्महद्भिर्धर्मसंश्रितैः । शासनं तव यद् युक्तं तद् भवाननुमन्यताम्॥
en: For these causes of very great moment, favoured by virtue, I have adininistered to you this condign punishment. Do you now approve it.

sa: तद् धर्मिष्ठं यशस्यं च वचनं सत्यवादिनः॥ श्रुत्वा विदेहाधिपतिः परं विस्मयमागतः।
en: Hearing these words of the truthful (king), chiming in with morality and conducive to fame, the lord of Videha was filled with admiration.

sa: युष्माकं तु बलं ज्ञातं बहुशो रणमूर्धने। अतस्तस्मिञ्जनस्थाने मया यूयं निवेशिताः॥
en: I have been well acquainted with your strength in many a field, and it is for this that I set you in Janasthāna.

sa: जामदग्न्यो गतो रामः प्रयातु चतुरङ्गिणी। अयोध्याभिमुखी सेना त्वया नाथेन पालिता॥
en: Now that Jamadagni's son has gone away, let the fourfold forces maintained by you as their lord, march in the direction of Ayodhyā.

sa: अनुजातो हि मां सर्वैर्गुणैः श्रेष्ठो ममात्मजः। पुरन्दरसमो वीर्ये रामः परपुरंजयः॥
en: My worthy son, like to Purandara himself in prowess, Rāma, the conqueror of hostile cities, had been born, endowed with all my virtues.

sa: मन्नियोगादिमं देशं कुरु निष्कण्टकं पुनः। नहि कश्चिदिमं देशं शक्तो ह्यागन्तुमीदृशम्॥
en: And, by my direction, do you again rid this region of its thorn; for no one dare to approach such a place, infested,

sa: स चिन्तयानो वैदेहीं कामबाणैः प्रपीडितः। प्रविवेश गृहं रम्यं सीतां द्रष्टुमभित्वरन्॥
en: And brooding over Vaidehi, he, sore pierced by the shafts of Kāma, hastily entered his charming mansion, with the intention of secing Sitā.

sa: रथाह्वहंसानत्यूहाः पल्वाः कारण्डवाः परे। तथा पुंस्कोकिलाः क्रौञ्चा विसंज्ञा भेजिरे दिशः।॥
en: And wild with alarm, Chakravakas, and swans, and Natyuhas, and Plavas, and Karandavas, and male coels, and Kraunchas, fled away in all directions.

sa: आजगाम ततो वाली हत्वा तं वानरर्षभः। ततोऽहमददां राज्यं गौरवाद् भययन्त्रितः॥ स मां जिघांसुर्दुष्टात्मा वाली प्रव्यथितेन्द्रियः। परिकालयते वाली धावन्तं सचिवैः सह॥
en: Then came that foremost of monkeys, having slain him (Mahisa). Thereupon I, influenced by fear, in consideration of his dignity, made over to him his monarchy. But Vali, his senses exercised with sorrow, anxious to slay me, in company with his counsellors, pursued me, who heels.

sa: ते श्रान्तवाहना दूता विकृष्टेन सता पथा। गिरिव्रजं पुरवरं शीघ्रमासेदुरञ्जसा ॥
en: And with their vehicles fatigued, the ambassadors, on account of the great distance of the way; speedily reached that best of cities, Girivraja.

sa: दृष्ट्वा तु नृपतिः श्रीमानेकचित्तगतं पुरम्। निपपातैव दुःखेन कृत्तमूल इव दुमः॥
en: And beholding the citizens absorbed in one thought, the auspicious monarch fell down in grief like a tree whose roots have been severed.

sa: राजा सर्वस्य लोकस्य धर्मचारी महारथः। पूजनीयश्च मान्यश्च भवान् प्राप्तः प्रियातिथिः॥
en: The sovereign of all the worlds, righteous, a mighty car warrior, worthy of being honoured and worshipped, you have become our beloved guest.

sa: दत्तपथ्यशना दूता जग्मुः स्वं स्वं निवेशनम्। केकयांस्ते गमिष्यन्तो हयानारुह्य सम्मतान्॥
en: Thereupon, having been furnished with the necessaries for the journey, they bound for Kekaya went to their respective abodes, mounted on goodly horses.

sa: महत्येषा हि ते बुद्धिरेष चाभ्युदयो महान्। एष स्वर्गस्य मार्गश्च यदेनमनुगच्छसि॥
en: This design of yours is great; this is your mighty good fortune; this is the way to heaven that you are following him.

sa: तस्य त्वेवं ब्रुवाणस्य संहतैर्वानरैः सह ॥ उत्पेततुस्तदा पक्षौ समक्षं वनचारिणाम्।
en: As he was speaking thus in the midst of the monkeys, his wings sprang up in presence of the rangers of the forest.

sa: नह्येनां शापसंसृष्टां कश्चिदुत्सहते पुमान्। निहन्तुं त्रिषु लोकेषु त्वामृते रघुनन्दन ॥
en: Nor, O son of Raghu, does any one in the three worlds, save, you, dare to slay this Yaksi joined with a curse.

sa: राजाभूत् त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतः स्वेन कर्मणा। निमिः परमधर्मात्मा सर्वसत्त्ववतां वरः॥
en: There was a king famed over the three worlds by his own acts, Nimi-eminently picus and the foremost of those endowed with strength.

sa: अस्य कार्यविषक्तस्य बद्धवैरस्य राक्षसैः। तस्य सीता हृता भार्या रावणेन यशस्विनी॥
en: He having created hostility with the Rākṣasas, his illustrious wife, Sītā, while he was engrossed in some work, was carried away by Ravana.

sa: कृत्स्नं वनमिदं दृष्टं श्रोतव्यं च श्रुतं त्वया। तदिच्छाम्यभ्यनुज्ञाता त्यक्ष्याम्येतत् कलेवरम्॥
en: You have observed this entire forest and heard every thing worth hearing. I purpose now to renounce my body being commanded by you.

sa: तमेवमुक्त्वा सौहार्दाद् भ्रातरं लक्ष्मणाग्रजः। उवाच भूयः कौसल्यां प्राञ्जलिः शिरसा नतः॥
en: Saying these words to Lakşmaņa out of fraternal affection, spoke again Rāma to Kausalyā with clasped hands and with his head bending low.

sa: परितुष्टोऽस्मि भद्रं ते राजपुत्र महायशः। प्रीत्या परमया युक्तो ददाम्यस्त्राणि सर्वशः॥
en: Pleased am I with you. Good betide you, O highly famous prince! With supreme pleasure, do I confer upon you all the weapons.

sa: सकामा भव कैकेयि विधवा राज्यमावस। नहि तं पुरुषव्याघ्रं विना जीवितुमुत्सहे॥
en: O Kaikeyi, do you realise your desire, do you becoming a widow, rule this kingdom. Without that best of men I cannot live.

sa: यथा ह्यनुदका नद्यो यथा वाप्यतृणं वनम्। अगोपाला यथा गावस्तथा राष्ट्रमराजकम्॥
en: Even as a river without water, a wood without grass, a herd of kine without a keeper, is a kingdom without a king.

sa: बुद्ध्याहमनुपश्यामि न त्वं रामस्य संयुगे॥ स्थातुं प्रतिमुखे शक्तः सबलोऽपि महारणे।
en: Meseems, you backed by your forecast are incapable of staying in battle before Rāma in high encounter. Some texts-(Rāma) equipped with the bow.

sa: यदि रामममित्रघ्नं न त्वमद्य वधिष्यसि ॥ तव चैवाग्रतः प्राणांस्त्यक्ष्यामि निरपत्रपा।
en: If you do not to-day slay that destroyer of foes, Rāma, I shall banishing shame, give up my life in your very presence.

sa: न तत्राक्रमितुं नागाः शक्नुवन्ति तदाश्रमे। ऋषेस्तस्य मतङ्गस्य विधानात् तच्च काननम्॥
en: Fearing the divine authority of that great ascetic Matanga, the elephants, though there are many, dare not cross the threshold of his asylum.

sa: अरण्यं विचरामीदमेका सर्वभयंकरा। रावणो नाम मे भ्राता यदि ते श्रोत्रमागतः॥
en: Striking terror into the hearts of all, I range this forest alone. My brother is named Ravana* You may have heard of him.

sa: ततोऽब्रुवन् सुराः सर्वे भगवन्तं पितामहम्। प्रणिपत्य सुरा राम सेन्द्राः साग्निपुरोगमाः॥।
en: And, O Rāma, the gods with Agni at their head, bowing to him, addressed that possessor of the six attributes, the Grand-sir, saying,

sa: वीरो विश्रवसः पुत्रो यदि ते श्रोत्रमागतः। प्रवृद्धनिद्रश्च सदा कुम्भकर्णो महाबलः॥ विभीषणस्तु धर्मात्मा स तु राक्षसचेष्टितः। प्रख्यातवीर्यौ च रणे भ्रातरौ खरदूषणौ॥
en: My brother Råvana is a valiant son of Viśravā if you have heard of him. And he that is given to long sleep-the mighty Kumbhakarna, the righteous Vibhīşaņa, who never serves the Rākşasas, and the brothers Khara and Düşaņa renowned in conflict (are also my brothers).

sa: इमां विरूपामसती कराला निर्णतोदरीम्। अनेन सह ते भ्रात्रा भक्षयिष्यामि मानुषीम्॥
en: This unsightly, grim unchaste and human one with me, with a lean abdomen, will I devour up, along with this brother of yours.

sa: वयं तु लोभान्मोहाच्च दम्भं मानं च संश्रिताः। इमामवस्थां सम्प्राप्ता राज्यलाभबुभुत्सया॥
