en: Full of pride and haughtiness, we however, through covetousness and folly and from desire of enjoying the kingdom, have fallen into this plight.

sa: तत्र चैनं समुत्सृज्य भ्रातरौ जग्मतुर्ग्रहान्। ततस्तौ वै शशापाथ त्रितो ब्राह्मणसत्तमः॥
en: His two brothers, dashing him down into a pit, had returned home. That foremost of Brahmanas, viz., Trita, had thereupon cursed them both."

sa: हतारोहा यथा नागाश्छिन्नहस्ता यथा नराः। सर्वे पार्थमयं लोकं सम्पश्यन्तो भयार्दिताः॥
en: They behaved like elephants without riders and men without arms. Stricken with fear they thought that the entire universe was filled with Partha.

sa: संजय उवाच तं पातितं ततो दृष्ट्वा महाशालमिवोद्गतम्। प्रहृष्टमनसः सर्वे दद्दशुस्तत्र पाण्डवाः॥ उन्मत्तमिव मातङ्ग सिंहेन विनिपातितम्। दद्दशुर्हष्टरोमाण: सर्वे ते चापि सोमकाः॥
en: Sanjaya said Seeing Duryodhana struck down on Earth like a gigantic Shala uprooted by the storm, the Pandavas were filled with delight. The Somakas also saw, with their hair standing erect, the Kuru king felled upon the Earth, like an infuriate clephant felled by a lion.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा तु नृपतिं प्रयातौ स्वो यथेप्सितम्। संजयश्च यथाकामं प्रविवेश स्वमन्दिरम्॥
en: Having said so to that king both of us left him for coming to where we wished, and Srinjaya returned to his palace.

sa: दण्डेन नीयते चेदं दण्डं नयति वा पुनः। दण्डनीतिरिति ख्याता त्रील्लोकानभिवर्तते॥
en: And because men will be governed by punishment, therefore will this science be known in the three worlds as Dandaniti (science of punishment).

sa: ततो दुर्योधनं हत्वा भीमसेनः प्रतापवान्। पातितं कौरवेन्द्र तमुपगम्येदमब्रवीत्॥ गौगौरिति पुरा मन्द द्रौपदीमेकवाससम्। यत् सभायां हसन्नस्मांस्तदा वदसि दुर्मते॥ तस्यावहासस्य फलमद्य त्वं समवाप्नुहि। एवमुक्त्वा स वामेन पदा मौलिमुपास्पृशत्॥ शिरश्च राजसिंहस्य पादेन समलोडयत्।
en: Having struck Duryodhana down the brave Bhimasena, approaching the Kuru chief, addressed him, saying-O wretch, formerly laughing at Draupadi who had no cloth in the midst of the assembly, you, O fool, called us Cows. Bear now the consequences of that insult. Saying so, he struck the head of his fallen foe, with his left foot. Indeed, he struck the head of that best of kings with his foot.

sa: अमी रामहृदाः पञ्च दृश्यन्ते पार्थ दूरतः। तेषु संतर्पयामास पितॄन् क्षत्रियशोणितैः॥
en: 'Yonder, at a distance, O Partha' are the five lakes of Rama. There Rama offered oblations of Kshatriya blood to his departed manes.

sa: यजस्व वाजिमेधेन विधिवद् दक्षिणावता। वयं ते किंकराः पार्थ वासुदेवश्च वीर्यवान्॥
en: Celebrate with due rites and enough presents the horse-sacrifice. We are your servants, O son of Pritha, as also the highly energetic Vasudeva.

sa: न गृहे मरणं तात क्षत्रियाणां प्रशस्यते। शौटीराणामशौटीर्यमधर्म कृपणं च तत्॥
en: The death of a Kshatriya at home is not praiseworthy. They are heroes. Any unheroic act on their part is sinful and censurable.

sa: अहं च पर्वतश्चैव स्वस्त्रीयो मे महामुनिः। वस्तुकामावभिगतौ संजयं जयतां वरम्॥
en: Myself, and my sister's son, the great ascetic Parvata, once came to Srinjaya, that foremost of all victorious kings, for living with him.

sa: अहं हि भृशमापन्नस्त्वमापनतरो मम। द्वयोरापन्नयोः संधिः क्रियतां मा चिराय च॥
en: I am surely in great distress. You are, if possible, in greater distress still! Let there be an agreement made between us forthwith.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ते समासाद्य गङ्गां तु शिवां पुण्यजलोचिताम्। ह्रदिनीं च प्रसन्नां च महारूपां महावनाम्॥ भूषणान्युत्तरीयाणि वेष्टनान्यवमुच्य च। ततः पितॄणां भ्रातॄणां पौत्राणां स्वजनस्य च॥ पुत्राणामार्यकाणां च पतीनां च कुरुस्त्रियः। उदकं चक्रिरे सर्वा रुदत्यो भृशदुःखिताः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Arrived at the holy Ganga full of sacred water, containing many lakes, adorned with high banks and broad shores, and having a vest bed, they threw off their ornaments, upper garments, and belts and girdles. The Kuru ladies, crying and stricken with great sorrow offered oblations of water of their fathers and grandsons and brothers and kinsmen and sons and seniors and husbands. Conversant with duties, they also performed the water-rite for their friends.

sa: चराचराणां भूतानां रक्षणं चापि सर्वशः। यथार्हपूजां च तथा कुर्वन् गाहस्थ्यमावसेत्॥
en: That king, who protects all creatures mobile and immobile, and honours them duly, attains to the object of the Garhasthya mode of life.

sa: सर्वाश्चैव प्रजा नित्यं राजा धर्पण पालयन्। उत्थानेन प्रदानेन पूजयेच्चापि धार्मिकान्॥
en: Virtuously protecting all his subjects he should honour all pious persons by standing up when they come and by making presents to them.

sa: तेऽपि सर्वे महेष्वासा अयुद्धार्थिनि कौरवे। निर्बन्धं परमं चक्रुस्तदा वै युद्धकाङ्क्षिणः॥
en: Finding the Kuru king reluctant to fight, those great bowmen, themselves desirous of fighting, began to urge him greatly to accept their advice.

sa: न हरण्येन शक्येत गन्तुं मृगगणैरिव। तस्मात् सेनासु तानेव योजयन्ति जयार्थिनः॥
en: The troops must not, like animals, be marched through forests. Kings desirous of victory should, therefore, follow good roads for marching their army.

sa: शराभिघातदुःखात् ते कच्चिद् गात्रं न दूयते। मानसादपि दुःखाद्धि शारीरं बलवत्तरम्॥
en: I hope your limbs are not afflicted by the pain originating from the wounds inflicted by arrows? Mental grief also weakens the body.

sa: भीष्म उवाच विद्यालक्षणसम्पन्नाः सर्वत्र समदर्शिनः। एते ब्रह्मसमा राजन् ब्राह्मणाः परिकीर्तिताः॥
en: Those Brahmanas, o king, who are learned and beneficent, and who look upon all creatures impartially, are said to be equal to। Brahma.

sa: दुर्योधनोऽपि धर्मात्मा गतिं यास्यति शाश्वतीम्। ऋजुयोधी हतो राजा धार्तराष्ट्रो नराधिपः॥
en: The righteous Duryodhana, on the other hand, shall acquire cternal blessedness! Dhritarashtra's royal son, who has been struck down, is a fair warrior!

sa: सृष्टास्तु बाणा भरतर्षभेण शतं शतानीव सुवर्णपुङ्खाः॥ प्राच्छादयन् कर्णरथं क्षणेन युगान्तवयर्ककरप्रकाशाः।
en: O Bharata race, they were brilliant as the Yuga fire or the sun's rays ten thousand arrows in not time covered Karna's car.

sa: ततोऽस्य निशितैर्बाणैः सर्वान् हत्वा पदानुगान्॥ अभ्यगाद् भारती सेनां हतशेषां महारथः।
en: Killing next all the followers, of Susharman with his keen arrows, the great car-warrior Arjuna proceeded against the remnant of the Bharata army.

sa: सुषेणस्तु ततः क्रुद्धः पाण्डवं विशिखैस्त्रिभिः। सुतसोमं तु विंशत्या बाह्वोरुरसि चार्पयत्॥
en: Then Sushena, filled with rage, struck the son of Pandu with three arrows and Sutasoma with twenty in the arms and the chest.

sa: दण्डेनोपनतं शत्रु यो राजा न नियच्छति। स मृत्युमुपगृह्णाति गर्भमश्वतरी यथा॥
en: That king who does not crush down an enemy by military force, provides for his own death like the crab when she conceives.

sa: तस्माद्धत्वाऽकृतप्रज्ञं लुब्धं कामवशानुगम्। लभतां पाण्डवः कामं धर्मेऽधर्मे च वा कृते॥
en: Having killed the covetous, foolish and passionate Duryodhana, let the son of Pandu satisfy his desire, be it by means fair or foul.

sa: दुर्विज्ञेया गतिर्नूनं कार्याणां कारणान्तरे। यद् वै लोकगुरुर्भूत्वा भवानेतां दशां गतः॥
en: The course of events is, forsooth, a mystery, since you, who were the master of the world, have been reduced to this state.

sa: शमेन तपसा चैव वीर्येण च समन्वितः। ववृधेऽतीव राजेन्द्र चन्द्रवत् प्रियदर्शनः॥
en: Possessed of self-restraint, asceticism and great energy, the child grew up. O king, into a person of highly charming features like Soma himself.

sa: श्रुतेन ब्रह्मचर्येण तपसा च दमेन च॥ ये समार.ध्य शूलाङ्कं भवसायुज्यमागताः।
en: Having worshipped the trident-handed deity with Vedic recitations, with Brahmacharya, with ascetic austerities, and with self-restraint, they have secured the companionship of Bhava.

sa: पूजन्युवाच वैरं पञ्चसमुत्थानं तच्च बुध्यन्ति पण्डिताः। स्त्रीकृतं वास्तुजं वाजं ससापत्नापराधजम्॥
en: Pujani said Emmity originates from five causes. Learned persons know it. Those five catises are woman, land, harsh words, natural disagreement, and injury.

sa: इन्द्रो वै ब्रह्मणः पुत्रः क्षत्रियः कर्मणाभवत्। ज्ञातीनां पापवृत्तीनां जघान नवतीनव॥
en: Indra himself, though a Brahmana, become a Kshatriya in his deeds, and fought with his sinful kinsmen for eight hundred and ten times.

sa: नारदस्य वचः श्रुत्वा तदाशोचन्त पाण्डवाः। एवं ते सर्वमाख्यातं देवगुह्यं सनातनम्॥
en: Hearing these words of Narada, the Pandavas were filled with grief. I have thus communicated to you, an eternal secret of the celestials.

sa: अथोद्यम्य गदे घोरे सशृङ्गाविव पर्वतौ। तावाजघ्नतुरन्योन्यं मण्डलानि विचेरतुः॥ क्रियाविशेषकृतिनौ रणभूमितलेऽचलौ।
en: Uplifting their terrible weapons, they again strucks each other like mountains striking each other with their summits at the time of an earthquake.

sa: दुर्योधनश्च तान् वीरान् वारयामास सान्त्वयन्॥ न चास्य शासनं केचित्तत्र चक्रुर्महारथाः।
en: Speaking mildly Duryodhana tried to prevent those warriors from fighting with the foe. No great car-warrior, however, amongst them carried out his order.

sa: यं दृष्ट्वा पितुरुत्सङ्गे शयानं देवरूपिणम्। अन्योन्यमब्रुवन् देवाः कमयं धास्यतीति वै॥
en: Seeing that child of celestial beauty lying on the lap of his father, the gods asked one another,-whose breasts shall this child suck?

sa: चाण्डालस्तद् वचः श्रुत्वा महर्षे वितात्मनः। शयनादुपसम्भ्रान्त उद्ययौ प्रति तं ततः॥
en: Hearing these words of that great Rishi of pure soul the Chandala rose up in fear from his bed and approached the sage.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच अयुद्धेनैव विजयं वर्धयेद् वसुधाधिपः। जघन्यमाहुर्विजयं युद्धेन च नराधिप॥
en: Yudhishthira said The king should acquire victories without battles. Victories won by battles are not spoken of highly, O king, by the wise.

sa: ते मन्यमाना राज्ञस्तु सम्प्रदानमनुत्तमम्। राजानं तुष्टुवुः प्रीता दत्त्वा चैवाशिषः शुभाः॥
en: The Brahmanas regarded those valuable gifts as presented by the king. Gladly they lauded the king and conferred their sacred blessing upon him.

sa: तदस्य तप्यमानस्य ज्ञातीनां संक्षयेन वैः॥ ज्येष्ठस्य पाण्डुपुत्रस्य शोकं भीष्म व्यपानुद।
en: Remove now the sorrow of the eldest son of Pandu who is burning with sorrow on account of the destruction of his kinsinen.

sa: संजय उवाच एवमुक्तो महाराज धर्मपुत्रेण धीमता। सलिलस्थस्तव सुत इदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Sanjaya continued Thus addressed, O king, by the intelligent son of Dharma, your son answered him from within the waters in these words.

sa: भगीरथं च राजानं मृतं संजय शुश्रुम। यस्येन्द्रो वितते यज्ञे सोमं पीत्वा मदोत्कटः॥ असुराणां सहस्राणि बहूनि सुरसत्तमः। अजयद् बाहुवीर्येण भगवान् पाकशासनः॥
en: We hear, O Srinjaya, that king Bhagiratha also died. In one of the sacrifices of that king inebriate with drinking the Soma juice, Indra, the worshipful chastiser of Paka and the king of the gods, defeated by the strength of his arms, many thousands of Asuras.

sa: प्रसादये त्वां भगवन्नपराधं क्षमस्व मे॥ मम दीनस्य लुब्धस्य मौर्येण हतचेतसः।
en: I am an insensate fool, a wretch filled with avarice. You are my refuge and protector, you should extend to me your favour.'

sa: भीष्म उवाच अत्रायं क्षेमदर्शीय इतिहासोऽनुगीयते। तत् तेऽहं सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि तन्निबोध युधिष्ठिर।॥
en: Bhishma said “Regarding it the story of Kshemadarshin is often related. I shall describe that story to you. Listen to it, O Yudhishthira.

sa: आजघ्नुः करजैश्चापि पाणिभिश्च शिरांस्युत॥ लुलुचुश्च तदा केशान् क्रोशत्यस्तत्र तत्र ह।
en: They tore their bodies with their nails and struck their heads with their hands and loosened their braids, crying all the while aloud.

sa: इत्येतानेवमुक्त्वा त्वं स्वयं धर्मभृतां वर। कथमद्य पुनर्वीर विनिहंसि मनांसि नः॥
en: O foremost of the virtuous, having yourself said these words to your brothers then, why, O hero, do you depress our hearts now?

sa: विधवा यस्य विषये नानाथा: काश्चनाभवन्। सदैवासीत् पितृसमो रामो राज्यं यदन्वशात्॥
en: In his kingdom there were no widows and none that was helpless. Indeed, Rama while governing his kingdom always followed his father Dasharatha.

sa: अतीत्य ता महाबाहुः क्रोशन्तीः कुररीरिव। ववन्दे पितरं ज्येष्ठं धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: Leaving those ladies crying like a fight of she-ospreys, the mighty-armed king Yudhishthira the just bowed to the feet of his eldest uncle.

sa: यदा कृष्णामुपादाय प्राद्रवत् केकयैः सह। तदैव वध्यः पाण्डूनां जनार्दन जयद्रथः॥
en: At that time, O Janarddana, when Jayadratha, assisted by the Kekayas, tried to ravish Draupadi, he should have been killed by the Pandavas.

sa: प्रतिगृह्णीष्व पुत्रं स्वं मया दत्तमनिन्दितम्। इत्युक्तः प्रतिजग्राह प्रीति चावाप पुष्कलाम्॥
en: Given by me, accept this faultless child of your own!' Thus addressed by her, the Rishi accepted the child and was highly pleased.

sa: मुह्यता तु मनुष्येण प्रष्टव्याः सुहृदो जनाः॥ तत्रास्य बुद्धिर्विनयस्तत्र श्रेयश्च पश्यति।
en: A man that is beside himself should seek the advice of his friends. In friends consists his understanding, his humility and his prosperity.

sa: तानि तान्यनुरक्तेन शक्यानि हि तितिक्षितुम्। मन्त्रिणां च भवेत् क्रोधो विस्फूर्जितमिवाशनेः॥
en: None save a servant devoted to the master stand and overlook such treatment. Ministers also become sometimes highly offended with their masters. can

sa: असिभिः पट्टिशैः शूलैस्तक्षमाणाः पुनः पुनः। तावकाः पाण्डवेयाश्च न न्यवर्तन्त भारत॥
en: Struck and wounded repeatedly with swords and battle-axes and lances, your warriors, as also the Pandavas, O Bharata, ceased to approach one another.

sa: अस्य चामीकराभस्य तप्तकाञ्चनसप्रभा। आस्याद् विनिः सृता जिह्वा भक्ष्यते कृष्ण पक्षिभिः॥५
en: There, the tongue of that king, beautiful like molten gold, looting out of his mouth, is, O। Krishna, being devoured by carnivorous birds.

sa: जीवितं संत्यजन्त्येके धनलोभपरा जनाः। न जीवितार्थं मन्यन्ते पुरुषा हि धनादृते॥
en: Some persons sacrifice life itself, actuated by the desire of acquiring wealth. These do not think that life without wealth has any use.

sa: यथान्तकमनुप्राप्य जीवन् कश्चिन्न मुच्यते। एवं बाह्वन्तरं प्राप्य तव जीवेन कश्चन॥
en: As no one can escape alive from a struggle with Death himself, so no body can come out safe from within your embrace.

sa: उद्दालकेन यजता पूर्वं ध्यात्वा सरस्वती। आजगाम सरिच्छेष्ठा तं देशं मुनिकारणात्॥
en: Before Ouddalaka began his sacrifice, he had thought of the Sarasvati. That foremost of rivers came there for the sake of those Rishis.

sa: कृष्णसारथिमायान्तं दृष्ट्वा श्वेतहयं रथम्॥ अर्जुनं चापि योद्धारं त्वदीया प्राद्रवन् भयात्।
en: Seeing his car drawn by white horses and driven by Krishna himself and Arjuna standing on it your soldiers fled away in fear.

sa: यच्च त्वं वक्ष्यसे भीष्म पाण्डवायानुपृच्छते। वेदप्रवाद इव ते स्थास्यते वसुधातले॥
en: Whatever, O Bhishma, you will say to the inquiring son of Pandu, will pass on Earth like the authoritative declarations of the Vedas.

sa: न हि युद्धेन पुत्रस्ते धर्येण स महाबलः। शक्यः केनचिदुद्यन्तुमतो विषममाचरम्॥
en: Your powerful son was incapable of being killed by anybody in a fair and righteous battle. And therefore I did what was unfair.

sa: कस्य वंशे समुत्पन्नः किं चाधीतं द्विजोत्तम। एतदिच्छाम्यहं श्रोतुं विधिवद् द्विजसत्तम।॥
en: In whose family was he born? What books did that great Rishi study? I desire to hear all this, O foremost of Rishis.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततस्ते पुरुषव्याघ्राः सदश्वरनिलोपमैः। अभ्ययुः सहदाशार्हाः शिविरं पुनरेव हि॥
en: Vaishampayana said “Those foremost of men, borne by their excellent horses, quick-coursing like the wind, came back with Dasharha hero, to their encampment.

sa: तस्मिन् कुर्वीत विश्वासं राजा कस्याञ्चिदापदि। तापसेषु हि विश्वासमपि कुर्वन्ति दस्यवः॥
en: Whatever the distress which he befalls him, he should confide in an anchorite. The very ribbers place confidence upon persons of that character.

sa: ततो राज्ञाभ्यनुज्ञातो भीमसेनो महाबलः। प्रददौ तं मणि दिव्यं वचनं चेदमब्रवीत्॥ अयं भद्रे तव मणिः पुत्रहन्तुर्जितः स ते। उत्तिष्ठ शोकमुत्सृज्य क्षात्रधर्ममनुस्मर॥
en: Then the powerful Bhimasena, desired by the king, gave that celestial gem to her and said these words: 'This gem, O amiable lady, is yours. The slayer of your sons had been defeated. Rise, shake off your sorrow, and recollect the duties of a Kshatriya lady.

sa: हतो दुर्योधन: पापो राज्यस्य परिपन्थिकः। दुःशासनस्य रुधिरं पीतं विस्फुरतो मया॥
en: The wretched Duryodhana, that thorn in the way of our sovereignty, has been killed. I have quaffed the blood of the living Dusshasana.

sa: गते वज्रधरे राजंस्तत्र वर्षं पपात ह।६०॥ पुष्पाणां भरतश्रेष्ठ दिव्यानां पुण्यगन्धिनाम्।
en: After the wielder of the thunderbolt, O king, had gone, a shower of celestial flowers of sweet fragrance fell there, O Bharata's chief.

sa: योगक्षेमाः प्रवर्तन्ते प्रजानां नात्र संशयः। वैदिकानि च सर्वाणि भवन्त्यपि गुणान्युत॥
en: Forsooth, all men succeed in acquiring the objects they seek and preserving those that have been acquired. All the Vedic rites yield merit.

sa: जागर्ति कालः पूर्वं च मध्ये चान्ते च भारत। ईश्वरः सर्वलोकस्य महादेवः प्रजापतिः॥ देवदेवः शिवः सर्वो जागर्ति सततं प्रभुः। कपर्दी शङ्गो रुद्रः शिवः स्थाणुरुमापतिः॥
en: Time, O Bharata, is always awake, in the beginning, the middle, and the end. The lord of all the worlds, the lord of all creatures, the powerful and blessed Mahadeva, the god of gods, is always awake, He passes also by the names Kapardin, Shankara, Rudra, Bhava, Sthanu, and the lord of Uma.

sa: वेदा यस्माच चत्वारः सर्वाण्यस्त्राणि केशव। अनपेतानि वै शूराद् यथैवादौ प्रजापतैः॥
en: The four Vedas, and all kinds, of weapons, O Keshava, did not leave that hero even as they do not the Lord Prajapati.

sa: ततः संदर्शयामास स्वरूपं भगवान् हरः। ततोऽब्रवीत् तदा तेभ्यस्तस्याश्च चरितं महत्॥
en: The adorable Hara appeared there in his own form. Pleased, he spoke to them about the noble conduct of Arundhati (in these words).

sa: अपध्वस्तो ह्यवमतो दुःखं जीवति जीवितम्। जीवितं यदपक्रुष्टं यथैव मरणं तथा॥
en: One becoming poor after being rich leads a life of humiliation and sorrow. A life of humiliation and censure is like death itself.

sa: अनश्नन्त्याः पचन्त्याश्च शृण्वन्त्याश्च कथाः शुभाः। दिनोपमः स तस्याथ कालोऽतीतः सुदारुणः॥
en: Without food and employed in cooking and listening to those sacred topics, that terrible period passed away as if like a single day.

sa: पांसुग्रस्ते ततः कूपे विचन्त्य सलिलं मुनिः। अग्नीन् संकल्पयामास होतॄनात्मानमेव च॥
en: Although the pit was dry still the sage perceived the existence of water and of sacrificial fires there. Imagining himself the sacrificial priest.

sa: दुराचारः क्षीणबलः परित्राणं न गच्छति। अथ तस्मादुद्विजते सर्वो लोको वृकादिव॥
en: By committing evil acts, a powerless men, can never escape. Men fear his conduct even as they are alarmed on seeing a wolf.

sa: ततः स भगवान् ध्यात्वा चिरं शूलवरायुधः। आत्मानमात्मना दण्डं ससृजे देवसत्तमः॥
en: Thus addressed, that foremost of gods, armed with an enormous Shula, thinking for some time, converted his ownself into the form of Punishment.

sa: धृतराष्ट्रं यथापूर्वं गान्धारी विदुरं तथा॥ सर्वांश्च कौरवान् मान्यान् भृत्यांश्च समपूजयत्।
en: He showed due honour as before, to Dhritarashtra, and Gandhari, and Vidura, and to all the Kaurava elders and to all the officers.

sa: मा स्म लुब्धांश्च मूल्श्च च प्रयूयुजः। अलुब्धान् बुद्धिसम्पन्नान् सर्वकर्मसु योजयेत्॥
en: Never appoint persons covetous and foolish in matters of Pleasure and profit. You should always appointmen who are free from covetousness and intelligent.

sa: इत्युक्तोऽङ्गिरसां श्रेष्ठमामन्त्र्य प्रतिपूज्य च। जगाम सहसा रामं महेन्द्रं पर्वतं प्रति॥
en: When Drona had answered thus, Karna, having adored him, took his permission and proceeded forthwith to Rama then living on the Mahendra mountains.

sa: उवाच नियमज्ञा च कल्याणी सा प्रियंवदा। भगवन् मुनिशार्दूल किमाज्ञापयसि प्रभो॥
en: Conversant with vows, the auspicious and sweet-speeched damsel addressed him, saying-"O worshipful one, O foremost of ascetics, tell me your commands, O lord.

sa: गृहाण चक्रमित्युक्तो मया तु तदनन्तरम्। जग्राहोत्पत्य सहसा चक्र सव्येन पाणिना॥
en: I said to him take it. Thus spoken to, he rose all on a sudden and seized the discus with his left hand.

sa: तां तु सेनां महाराज मद्रराजः प्रतापवान्। अपादयद् रणे शूरः सेनापतिररिंदमः॥
en: Their General however, the brave and valiant king of the Madras, that repressor of foes, then protected, O king, those troops in battle.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमाश्वासितस्तेन संजयेन महात्मना। विदुरो भूय एवाह बुद्धिपूर्वं परंतप॥
en: Thus was the king consoled by the great Sanjaya. Vidura then, O scorcher of foes, once again addressed the king, showing great intelligence."

sa: मम प्रियकरी चापि सततं प्रियदर्शने॥ तस्मात् सारस्वतः पुत्रो महांस्ते वरवर्णिनि।
en: Highly beautiful, you have done me great good! This your great child, O fair river, will be known by the name of Sarasvat.

sa: क्षिप्ता ह्येका यदा शक्तिः सुघोराऽनलसूनुना। तत: कट्यो विनिष्पेतुः शक्तीनां भरतर्षभ॥
en: When that terrible dart was once hurled by the son of Agni, millions of darts came out of it, O best of Bharatas.

sa: ततस्तां भगवान् नीति पूर्वं जग्राह शङ्करः। बहुरूपो विशालाक्षः शिवः स्थाणुरुमापतिः॥
en: After this, the husband of Uma,—the divine and many-formed Shiva of large eyes, the source of all blessings, first read and mastered it.

sa: उच्छृतं चाग्निशृङ्गं च महापाषाणयोधिनौ॥ प्रददावग्निपुत्राय विध्यः पारिषदावुभौ।
en: Vindhya gave Angi's son two companions named Uchchhrita and Agnishringa both of whom fought with stones.

sa: सत्यं चेदं ब्रह्मणा पूर्वमुक्तं दण्डः प्रजा रक्षति साधु नीतः। पश्याग्नयश्च प्रतिशाम्य भीताः संतर्जिता दण्डभयाज्ज्वलन्ति॥
en: Formerly Brahman himself, said that chastisement, properly applied, maintains creatures. Behold, the very fires, when put out, blaze up again, in fright, when blown! This is owing to the fear of force.

sa: विश्वामित्रोऽथ भगवान् महर्षिरनिकेतनः। क्षुधापरिगतो धीमान् समन्तात् पर्यधावत॥
en: The holy and great Rishi Vishvamitra, endued with great intelligence, wandered homeless and stricken with hunger.

sa: शासनाद् धर्मराजस्य क्षत्ता सूतश्च संजयः। सुधर्मा धौम्यसहित इन्द्रसेनादयस्तथा॥ चन्दनागुरुकाष्ठानि तथा कालीयकान्युत। घृतं तैलं च गन्धांश्च क्षौमाणि वसनानि च॥ समाहृत्य महार्हाणि दारूणां चैव संजयान्। रथांश्च मृदितांस्तत्र नानाप्रहरणानि च॥ चिताः कृत्वा प्रयत्नेन यथामुख्यान् नराधिपान्। दाहयामासुरव्यग्राः शास्त्रदृष्टेन कर्मणा॥
en: Vaishampayana said Thus commanded by king Yudhishthira the just, Vidura, Sanjaya, Sudharman, Dhaumya and Indrasena and others, procuring sandal and other kinds of wood used on such occasions, as also clarified butter and oil and perfumes and rich silken robes and other kinds of cloth, and large heaps of dry wood, and broken car and various kinds of weapons, caused funeral pyres to be duly made and lighted and then without delay burnt duly, the dead bodies of the kings.

sa: ब्राह्मणेभ्यो ददौ निष्कान् सदसि प्रतते नृपः। तुभ्यं निष्कं तुभ्यं निष्कमिति क्रोशन्ति वै द्विजाः।।१२४ सहस्रं तुभ्यमित्युक्त्वा ब्राह्मणान् सम्प्रपद्यते।
en: King Rantideva used to make presents to the. When the king said,-To you I give a hundred Nishkas! To you I give a hundred Nishkas! To you I give a hundred-the Brahinanas raised a hue and cry of refusal.

sa: एकं हत्वा यदि कुले शिष्टानां स्यादनामयम्। कुलं हत्वा च राष्ट्रं च न तद् वृत्तोपघातकम्॥
en: If by killing a single individual a family may be saved, or, if by killing a single family the whole kingdom may be saved, such an act of slaughter is not sinful.

sa: तामुपेत्य निरानन्दा दुःखशोकसमन्विताम्। परिवार्य व्यतिष्ठन्त पाण्डवाः सहकेशवाः॥
en: Approaching the cheerless princess laden with sorrow and grief, the Pandavas with Keshava, sat round her.

sa: अभियाने तु पार्थस्य नरैर्नगरवासिभिः। नगरं राजमार्गाश्च यथावत्समलकृताः॥
en: During the march of Pritha's son, the city and its streets were adorned with lively citizens.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा पाण्डवं कृष्णा राजानं चारुदर्शना॥ भीमसेनमथागत्य परमं वाक्यमब्रवीत्। त्रातुमर्हसि मां भीम क्षत्रधर्ममनुस्मरन्॥ जहि तं पापकर्माणं शम्बरं मघवानिव।
en: Having said these words to the royal son of Pandu, the beautiful Krishna approached Bhimasena and said these importent words to him:-"Remembering the Kshatriya, O Bhima, you should help me. Kill that sinful wretch like Magavat slaying Sharmvara. were

sa: बहूनि च सहस्राणि ग्रामणित्वेऽभिवतिरे। निर्मर्यादानि दस्यूनां निरनुक्रोशवर्तिनाम्॥
en: One day many thousands of irregular and merciless robbers desired to let him as their leader.

sa: तामाशां हृदये कृत्वा समाश्वस्य च भारत। मद्रराजं च समरे समाश्रित्य महारथम्॥ नाथवन्तं तदाऽऽत्मानममन्यन्त सुतास्तव।
en: Cherishing that hope in his heart and being comforted, O Bharata, your son Duryodhana, relying in battle upon that great car-carrier, the ruler of the Madras, thought himself as having a protector.

sa: वृकोदरस्त्वसम्भ्रान्तस्तमेवोद्धृत्य तोमरम्॥ यन्तारं मद्रराज्य निर्बिभेद ततो हृदि।
en: However taking out the weapon fearless Vrikodara struck therewith the driver of Shalya on the chest.

sa: अथ काले व्यतिक्रान्ते महत्यतिभयंकारे॥ अनावृष्टिरनुप्राप्ता राजन् द्वादशवार्षिकी।
en: After a dreadful long time a drought. O king, took place that extended over twelve years.

sa: स तु शूरो रणे यत्तः पीडितस्तैर्महारथैः। विकृत्य कार्मुकं घोरं वेगनं भारसाधनम्॥ सात्यकिं पञ्चविंशत्या शल्यो विव्याध मारिष। भीमसेनं तु सप्तत्या नुकलं सप्तभिस्तथा॥
en: The heroic king of the Madras, struggling carefully in that battle, thus afflicted by those grcat car-warriors, drew a formidable and strong bow capable of imparting great force to the shafts shot from it and pierced Satyaki, with twenty-five arrows and Bhima with seventy-three and Nakula with seven.

sa: अर्जुनं रथवंशेन द्रोणपुत्रपुरोगमाः॥ अयोधयन्त समरे परिवार्य महारथाः।
en: Led by Drona's son they surrounded that great car-warrior and fought with him discharging many arrows.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच दण्डनीतिश्च राजा च समस्तौ तावुभावपि। कस्य किं कुर्वतः सिद्ध्येत् तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह॥
en: Yudhishthira said There is the science of punishment; there is the king, and there are the subjects. Tell me, O grandfather, what advantage is derived by one of those from the others.

sa: तानापतत एवाशु हतशेषाद् बलार्णवात्॥ दंशितान्प्रतिजग्राह भीमसेनः प्रतापवान्। ते तु तं वै समासाद्य परिववः समन्ततः॥
en: The brave Bhimasena, clad in mail, received those warriors rushing quickly at him who were not killed amongst that ocean of troops. Approaching him, those warriors, encircled that hero on all sides.

sa: ज्वालाजिर्जा तथा ज्योतिरात्मजाय हुताशनः। ददावनुचरौ शूरौ परसैन्यप्रमाथिनौ॥
en: Agni gave him two heroic companions, grinders of hostile armies, who were named Jvalajihva and Jyoti.

sa: तेषु सर्वेषु तीर्थेषु स्वाप्लुत्य मुनिपुङ्गवाः। प्राप्य प्रीतिं परां चापि तपोलुब्धा विशारदाः॥ प्रययुर्हि ततो राजन् तेन तीर्थमसृग्वहम्। अथागम्य महाभागास्ततं तीर्थं दारुणं तदा।॥
en: Those foremost of ascetics, having bathed in all the tirthas and obtained great delight, became desirous of acquiring more merit. Those learned sages at last came. O king, to that tirtha where the Sarasvati flowed in a bloody current. Those highly blessed Rishis, arriving at that frightful tirtha.

sa: अद्य क्षत्तुर्वचः सत्यं स्मरतां ब्रुवतो हितम्। अद्यप्रभृति पार्थं च प्रेष्यभूत इवाचरन्॥ विजानातु नृपो दुःखं यत् प्राप्तं पाण्डुनन्दनैः।
en: Let him recollect today the time and wholesome words of Vidura. Let him from this day wait upon the Parthas as their slave. Let that king today feel the grief that had been experienced by the sons of Pandu.

sa: प्रनृत्तमुभयं वीर तेजसा तस्य मोहितम्। ब्रह्मादिभिः सुरै राजऋषिभिश्च तपोधनैः॥ विज्ञप्तो वै महादेव ऋषेरर्थे नराधिप। नायं नृत्येद् यथा देव तथा त्वं कर्तुमर्हसि॥
en: Then the celestials with Brahma at their head and the Rishis, having asceticism for their wealth, O king, all approached Mahadeva and informed him of the doings of the Rishi (Mankanaka). And they said to him-Thou shouldst, O god, do that which may prevent the Rishi from dancing."

sa: समासाद्य रणे ते तु राजानमपराजितम्॥ प्रत्युद्ययुर्महेष्वासाः पाण्डवानाततायिनः।
en: Approaching their invincible king in that battle, those great bowmen rushed against the Pandavas for fight.

sa: शकुनिस्तु रणे वीरो युधिष्ठिरमपीडयत्॥ तस्याश्वांश्चतुरो हत्वा सुबलस्य सुतो विभो। नादं चकार बलवत् सर्वसैन्यानि कोपयन्॥
en: The heroic Shakuni struck Yudhishthira in that battle. Having killed the four horses of the king the powerful son of Subala uttered a loud roar, making all the soldiers tremble with fear.

sa: जनमेजय उवाच उदपानं कथं ब्रह्मन् कथं च सुमहातपाः। पतितः किं च संत्यक्तो भ्रातृभ्यां द्विजसत्तम॥
en: Janamejaya said "What is the origin of Udapana? How did the great ascetic Trita fall into a pit there? Why was that foremost of Brahmanas thrown into that pit by his brothers?

sa: संरक्ष्यान् पालयेद् राजा स राजा राजसत्तमः। ये केचित् तान् न रक्षन्ति तैरर्थो नास्ति कश्चन॥
en: A king should protect those who are worthy of protection. The king who does this is the best of rulers. Those kings who do not perform the duty of protection live uselessly.

sa: ततः प्राप्तो महाराज धर्मराजः प्रतापवान्॥ द्वैपायनं ह्रदं घोरं यत्र दुर्योधनोऽभवत्। शीतामलजलं हृद्यं द्वितीयमिव सागरम्॥
en: Brave and righteous king Yudhishthira, O king, reached the lake Dvaipayana within which Duryodhana then was. Wide as the ocean itself, its view was delightful and its waters were cool and transparent.

sa: अम्बरीष उवाच कानि यज्ञे हवींष्यस्मिन् किमाज्यं का च दक्षिणा। ऋत्विजश्चात्र के प्रोक्तास्तन्मे ब्रूहि शतक्रतो॥
en: Ambarisha said What are the libations in that sacrifice? What are its liquid offerings? What is its Dakshina? Who, again, are its Ritwijas? Tell me all this, Operformer of a hundred sacrifices.

sa: सम्प्रयुक्ते निकृष्टे वा सत्यं वा यदि वानृतम्। प्रगृह्य बाहून् क्रोशते भग्ना भग्नाः परे इति॥
en: When a small army is engaged with a larger one, the leader of the former may shake hands with his men and cry aloud, saying,-The enemy is routed! The enemy is routed!

sa: इन्द्राशनिसमस्पर्शा गाण्डीवप्रेषिताः शराः॥ नरान् नागन् समाहृत्य हयांश्चापि विशाम्पते। अपतन्त रणे वाणाः पतङ्गा इव घोषिणः॥
en: Shot off the Gandiva, arrows, whose touch resembled that of Indra's thunder, striking men and elephants and horses, O king, fell in that battle with a noise like that of winged insects.

sa: तान् प्रेक्ष्य सहितान् सर्वाञ्जवेनोद्यतकार्मुकान्। सौबलोऽभ्यद्रवद् युद्धे पाण्डवानाततायिनः॥
en: Beholding those three warriors rushing quickly together with uplifted bows, Subala's son proceeded against the Pandavas.

sa: आगम्य सहसा केचिद् रथैः स्वर्णविभूषितैः॥ पाण्डवानामनीकेषु धृष्टद्युम्नमयोधयन्।
en: Some, advancing quickly on their cars decked with gold, fought with Dhrishtadyumna amid the Pandava army.

sa: अश्वपतिरुवाच सुखं च दुःखं च भवाभवात्मकं यदा विजानाति सुताहमेव च। न मद्विधे युज्यति राक्यमीदृशं विनिश्चयेनाभिगतोऽस्मि ते नृप॥
en: Ashvapati said : Neither happiness nor misery has any permanence. My daughter and myself are aware of this. Therefore, O king, you should not use such words towards me. Having (previously) made up my mind. I have come here.

sa: अथोत्तरः शुभैर्गन्धैर्माल्यैश्च विविधैस्तथा। अवकीर्यमाण: संहृष्टो नगरं स्वैरमागतः॥
en: In the meantime, Uttara, covered with various perfumes and garlands, slowly entered the city with delight.

sa: महीपते नरपतिर्ययातिः स्वर्गमास्थितः। महर्षिकल्पो नृपतिः स्वर्गाग्रयफलभुग विभुः॥
en: O monarch, dwelling in heaven Yayati, resembling a great Rishi, enjoyed the choicest blessings of heaven.

sa: कृपस्य रथमास्थाय वैराटिरकुतोभयः। प्रदक्षिणमुपावृत्य तस्थौ तस्याग्रतो बली॥
en: Going round, the powerful and fearless son of Virata, approached Kripa's car and stood before him.

sa: अश्वपतिरुवाच सावित्री नाम राजर्षे कन्येयं मम शोभना। तां स्वधर्मेण धर्मज्ञ स्नुषार्थे त्वं गृहाण मे॥
en: Ashvapati said : O royal sage, this fair damsel, named Savitri, is my daughter. O virtuous one, do you accept her for your daughter-in-law in conformity with the usage of your order.

sa: अदात् तु कुन्तिभोजाय सखा सख्ये महात्मने। साऽहं पित्रा च निकृता श्वशुरैश्च परंतप। अत्यन्तदुःखिता कृष्ण किं जीवितफलं मम॥
en: Gave me away to his friend, the largesouled Kuntibhoja; such a one was myself and abandoned by my father and my father-in-law. O chastiser of foes, meeting with great troubles, O Krishna, what is the use of my life?

sa: परिचारैर्गुणैश्चैव प्रश्रयेण दमेन च। सर्वकामक्रियाभिश्च सर्वेषां तुष्टिमादधे॥
en: By her ministrations, good qualities, affections, self-control and good services to all, she pleased every one.

sa: निगृह्य राजन् पार्थेभ्यो दद्यां किं दुष्कृतं भवेत्। इदं तु न प्रवर्तेयं निन्दितं कर्म भारत॥
en: 0 king, and make ever to the son of Pritha which will not be a hard thing to do; but I am not inched to do such a blamable deed, o Bharata.

sa: अथावमृद्गादङ्गुष्ठमङ्गुष्ठेन युधिष्ठिरः। प्रबोधनभयाद् राजा भीमं तं प्रत्यषेधयत्॥
en: The king Yudhishthira, apprehending discovery, pressed his thumb with his own and commanded Bhima to desist.

sa: हित्वा सुखं प्रतिध्येन्द्रियाणि तेन देवानामगमद् गौरवं सः। तथा नक्षत्राणि कर्मणामुत्र भान्ति रुद्रादित्या वसवोऽथापि विश्वे॥
en: Giving up pleasure and controlling his senses he obtains glory from the gods and similarly like the planets and Rudra and Aditya and the Vasus in the heaven shines resplendent through works.

sa: सहायोपचितिं कृत्वा व्यवसाय्य ततस्ततः। अनुदुष्येयुरपरे पश्यन्तस्तव पौरुषम्॥
en: Having collected their forces one by one, his enemies will join you at seeing your prowess.

sa: कुण्डलोष्णीषधारीणि जातरूपस्रजस्तथा। पतितानि स्म दृश्यन्ते शिरांसि रणमूर्धनि॥
en: 1 There were seen, fallen in the battle-field, heads having earrings and helmets and golden necklaces.

sa: तथानुयान्तं पुरुषप्रवीरं भीष्मः शरैरभ्यहनत् तरस्वी। स चापि भीष्मस्य हयान् निहत्य विव्याध पार्थो दशभिः पृषत्कैः॥
en: Bhishma shot an arrow at Arjuna and injured him when he saw him leaving that place so hideously. Arjuna on his part killed his horses and injured him by shooting ten arrows.

sa: तौ स्थौ वीर्यसम्पन्नौ दृष्ट्वा संग्राममूर्धनि। आचार्यशिष्यावजितौ कृतविद्यौ मनस्विनौ॥ समाश्लिष्टौ तदान्योन्यं द्रोणपार्थो महाबलौ। दृष्ट्वा प्राकम्पत मुहुर्भरतानां महद् बलम्॥
en: Beholding those car-warriors, in the field of battle, the preceptor and disciple, Drona and Partha, both endued with prowess, irrepressible, learned, high-minded and greatly powerful, engaged with each other, the huge army of the Bharatas continually trembled (in fear).

sa: येषां ज्यातलनिर्घोषो विस्फूर्जितमिवाशनेः। व्यश्रूयत महायुद्धे भीमघोषस्तरस्विनाम्॥ स्थघोषश्च बलवान् गन्धर्वाणां तरस्विनाम्। ते मे वाचं विजानन्तु सूतपुत्रा नयन्ति माम्॥
en: Let those powerful and quick-coursing Gandharvas, the clatter of whose cars is very great and the twang of whose bows in a great encounter is heard like the roar of thunder, understand that the Sutas are taking me away.

sa: गन्धमादनवासी तु प्रथितो गन्धमादनः। कोटीशतसहस्राणि हरीणां समकर्षत॥
en: The celebrated Gandhamadana, the dweller of the mountain Gandhamadana, gathered a hundred thousand crores of monkeys.

sa: तामुवाच स धर्मात्मा नृशंसं वत ते कृतम्। पतिं हत्वा कुलं चेदमुत्साद्य धनलुब्धया।॥ अयशः पातयित्वा मे मूर्ध्नि त्वं कुलपांसने। सकामा भव मे मातरित्युक्त्वा प्ररुरोद ह॥
en: (Thereupon), the virtuous (Bharata) said to her “You have committed a very cruel deed by killing your husband and exterminating the family actuated by greed of wealth alone. O accursed (woman) of (our) family, hurling disgrace upon my head, fulfill your desire now.” Saying this to her mother, he gave free vent to his tears.

sa: दुर्योधनस्य कर्णस्य शकुनेः सौबलस्य च। दुःशासनचतुर्थानामिदमासीद् विचेष्टितम्॥
en: Such was the resolution of four, namely Duryodhana, Karna, Shakuni, the son of Subala and Dushasana.

sa: वासुदेव उवाच शृणु राजन् यथा वाक्यमुक्तो राजा सुयोधनः। मध्ये कुरूणां राजेन्द्र सभायां तन्निबोध मे॥
en: Vasudeva said Hear, O king, the words that were said by me to the king Suyodhana in the midst of the kings in that council; listen to them, O chief among kings.

sa: कामा मनुष्यं प्रसजन्त एते धर्मस्य ये विघ्नमूलं नरेन्द्र। पूर्वं नरस्तान् मतिमान् प्रणिघल्लोके प्रशंसां लभतेऽनवद्याम्॥
en: Desires adhere to a man and they are the source of all impediments to virtue, O king of men. A wise man, having killed them beforehand, gained unspeakable praise in the world.

sa: यम उवाच उदाहृतं ते वचनं यदङ्गने शुभे न तादृक् त्वदृते श्रुतं मया। अनेन तुष्टोऽस्मि विनास्य जीवितं वरं चतुर्थं वरयस्व गच्छ च॥
en: Yama said: O auspicious and fair damsel. I never before heard such words as you have (just now) spoken from any other person than you. I am pleased with these. Do you ask for a fourth boon with the exception of Satyavana's life and then retrace your steps.

sa: त्वं मां यथावदं विदुर प्रशाधिं प्रज्ञापूर्वं सर्वमजातशत्रोः। यन्मन्यसे पथ्यमदीनसत्त्व श्रेयस्करं ब्रूहि तद् वै कुरूणाम्॥
en: Tell me, O Vidura, as suits the occasion, after exercising your wisdom, all that you consider to be beneficial for Ajatashatru; tell speak also what conduces to the good of the Kurus.

sa: इत्येवं प्रतिबुद्धः स रात्र्यन्ते राजसत्तमः। अब्रवीत् सहितान् भ्रातॄन् दयापन्नो मृगान् प्रति॥ ते उक्तो रात्रौ मृगैरस्मि स्वप्नान्ते हतशेषितैः। तन्तुभूताः स्म भद्रं ते दया नः क्रियतामिति॥
en: Awakening after the dream that foremost of kings, moved by pity towards the deer, thus spoke to his brothers assembled there. "Those deer that are still alive after the rest have been slaughtered all appeared before me last night and said "we remain as the seed of our species. Be blessed. Have compassion on us."

sa: जानन्त्येतत् कुरवः सर्व एव ये चाप्यन्ये भूमिपालाः समेताः। दुर्योधने राज्यमिहाभवद् यथा अरिंदमे फाल्गुने विद्यमाने॥
en: All the Kurus, know and so do all the other kings that are assembled, how this kingdom came under the possession of Duryodhana, during the life-time of Arjuna, the subduer of foes.

sa: अनाधृष्टिश्चेकितानो धृष्टकेतुश्च सात्यकिः। परिवार्य ययुः सर्वे वासुदेवधनंजयौ॥
en: Anadhristhi and Chekitana, Dhrishtaketu and Satyaki all went surrounding the king as also Vasudeva and Dhananjaya.

sa: एवं संयम्य चित्तानि यत्नतः पाण्डुनन्दनाः। संवत्सरमिमं तात तथाशीला बुभूषत। अथ स्वविषयं प्राप्य यथाकामं करिष्यथ॥
en: O sons of Pandu, thus controlling your minds with great efforts, spend, O children, this year, adorned with good manners. Then regaining your kingdom you may act according to your own pleasure.

sa: विसृज्य तु सुशर्माणं पाण्डवास्ते हतद्विषः। स्वबाहुबलसम्पन्ना ह्रीनिषेवा यतव्रताः॥ संग्रामशिरसो मध्ये तां रात्रिं सुखिनोऽवसन्। ततो विराटः कौन्तेयानतिमानुषविक्रमान्। अर्चयामास वित्तेन मानेन च महारथान्॥
en: Having released Susharma, the Pandavas, then enemies slain, endowed with the strength of arms, observant of vows, and modest, passed that night happily in the midst of the battle-field. Then Virata honoured, with wealth and respect, those mighty car-warriors, the of Kunti, who were gifted with superhuman prowess.

sa: तस्माद् वक्ष्यामि ते राजन् हितं यत् स्यात् कुरून् प्रति। वचः श्रेयस्करं धयं ब्रुवतस्तन्निबोध मे॥
en: Therefore shall I say to you, O king, what is good for the Kurus, listen to me, (while I am) speaking words that are conducive to your interests and consistent with morality.

sa: यस्य याते न पश्यन्ति भूमौ क्षिप्तं पदं पदम्। दक्षिणां यो धुरं युक्तः सुग्रीवसदृशो हयः॥
en: The horse, that is yoked to the right pole (of your car) and whose hoofs, as they are placed on the ground are hardly visible when running, is like Sugriva of Krishna.

sa: प्राकारस्थाश्च ये केचिनिशाचरगणास्तथा। प्रदुद्रुवुस्ते शतशः कपिभिः समभिद्रुताः॥
en: The night-wanderers that were stationed on the walls, attacked by the monkeys fled hurriedly by hundreds.

sa: यक्ष उवाच व्याख्यातः पुरुषो राजन् यश्च सर्वधनी नरः। तस्मात् त्वमेकं भ्रातृणां यमिच्छसि स जीवतु॥
en: The Yaksha said: O king, you have (truly) related as to what erson is possessed of all sorts of wealth. Therefore, one of your brothers whomever you wish, be restored to life.

sa: सावित्र्युवाच श्रमः कुतो भर्तृसमीपतो हि मे यतो हि भर्ता मम सा गतिधुवा। यतः पति नेष्यसि तत्र मे गतिः वचो निबोध मे॥
en: Savitri said : I do not feel fatigue as I am with my husband. I will surely follow the same path as my husband does. I will surely go thither where you are taking my lord to. O best of the celestials, listen again to what I say.

sa: नाहं क्वचित् संजय पाण्डवानां मिथ्यावृत्ति काञ्चन जात्वपश्यम्। सर्वां श्रियं ह्यात्मवीर्येण लब्धां पर्याकार्षुः पाण्डवा मह्यमेव॥
en: Never did I, O Sanjaya, observe any falsehood in the sons of Pandu. Having gained all their wealth through sheer strength of their own, have they made over the same to me.

sa: ईदृशोऽयं केशवस्तात विद्वान् विद्धि ह्येनं कर्मणां निश्चयज्ञम्। प्रियश्च नः साधुतमश्च कृष्णो नातिक्रामे वचनं केशवस्य॥
en: Such is this learned Keshava. Know him to be aware of the ethics of actions. The good Krishna is moreover our friend and I shall not act against the advice of Keshava.

sa: निन्दितास्मि त्वया वत्स न च निन्दा क्षमाम्यहम्। लोकेभ्यः सपदि भ्रश्येद् यो मां निन्देत पापकृत्॥
en: I have been insulted by your child and I do not forgive insults; that perpetrator of wicked deeds, who would insult me, would quickly be turned out of all regions of bliss.

sa: अजातशत्रु कुशलं स्म पृच्छेः पुनः पुनः प्रीतियुक्तं वदेस्त्वम्। जनार्दनं चापि समेत्य तात महामात्रं वीर्यवतामुदारम्॥
en: Repeatedly will you ask him who has created no enemies in affectionate terms about his health; and going, O son, near Janardana also, who is possessed of great qualities, heroic and noble-minded.

sa: यत् तु वाचा शक्यं कर्मणा वाऽपि पाण्डव। करिष्ये तदहं पार्थ न त्वाशंसे शमं परैः॥
en: Whatever is capable of being done by me, by speech or by deed, O Pandava, shall be done by me, O son of Pritha, but do not expect peace with the enemy;

sa: यश्चैव देवान् खाण्डवे सव्यसाची गाण्डीवधन्वा प्रजिगाय सेन्द्रान्। उपाहरत् पाण्डवो जातवेदसे यशो मानं वर्धयन् पाण्डवानाम्॥
en: Savyasachin, with the help of the Govinda bow, having subjugated the gods with Indra at their head, in the Agni and thus enhanced the honour and redwing of the sons of Pandu.

sa: तानि रामाय दत्तानि मयैवोपहतानि च॥ स्वनवन्त्यवकीर्णानि तस्मिन् विहतचेतसि। तान्यङ्के दर्शनीयानि कृत्वा बहुविधं तदा॥ तेन देवप्रकाशेन देवेन परिदेवितम्।
en: All those ornaments, which were handed over to Rāma, were collected by me when they fell tinkling on the ground, Rāma being beside himself with grief. And placing them on his lap, the god-like Rāma bewailed in various accents.

sa: एतच्छ्रुत्वा विदित्वा च सीता जनकनन्दिनी। आह रावणमुत्पाट्य राघवो मां नयत्विति॥ . प्रणम्य शिरसा देवीमहमार्यामनिन्दिताम्। राघवस्य मनोह्लादमभिज्ञानमयाचिषम् ॥
en: Hearing this and revolving within herself Sītā, Janaka's daughter, replied.-Discomfiting Rāvaņa, may Rāghava himself carry me hence,' And bowing my head to that worshipful and blameless dame, I wanted of her a token as might conduce to Rāghava's pleasure.

sa: चर्यमाणं तपस्तीव्र संतापयति राक्षसान्। देवदानवयक्षेभ्यो गृहीतश्च वरस्त्वया॥
en: The fierce austerities of vow-observing saints, performed at particular sacred spots, try the Rākş asas sore.

sa: ततः श्रुत्वा निनादं तं कपीनां कपिसत्तमः। सोऽभवद्धृष्टमानसः॥
en: Thereupon hearing the noise of these monkeys Sugriva, their chief, being greatly delighted, uplifted his tail.

sa: ततो युद्धं समभवद्यक्षराक्षससंकुलम्। व्यथिताश्चाभवंस्तत्र सचिवा राक्षसस्य ते।।।
en: And then there took place an encounter between the Yakşas and the Räksasa were smitten fiercely.

sa: कस्त्वं केन च कार्येण इह प्राप्तो वनालय। कथयस्वेह यत् तत्त्वं यावत् प्राणा धरन्ति ते॥
en: O you that had the woods for the home, who are you? And on what errand had you come hither? Tell me while yet you had your vital powers left in you.

sa: एवं विभीषणस्यापि स्वर्गस्थस्येव नन्दने। दशवर्षसहस्राणि गतानि नियतात्मनः॥
en: In this wise Vibhīşaņa like a deity in Nandana passed away ten thousand years, observing restrictions.

sa: ततस्ते राक्षसाः सर्वे विबुधान्समरे स्थितान्। नानाप्रहरणैोरैर्जघ्नुः शतसहस्रशः॥
en: Then the Rākşasas, with thousands of terrible weapons, began to belabour the deities in the encounter.

sa: अथोवाच स काकुत्स्थः समीपपरिवर्तिनम्॥ सौमित्रिं मित्रसंपन्नं लक्ष्मणं शुभलक्षणम्। विभीषणमिमं सौम्य लङ्कायामभिषेचय॥ अनुरक्तं च भक्तं च तथा पूर्वोपकारिणम्।
en: Thereupon Kakuthsha spoke to Lakşmaņa-the son of Sumitrā gifted with auspicious marks who was near him, "O gentle one, take this Vibhīşaņa to the city of Lankä ever devoted and attached to us, and who had done us good.

sa: ततस्ते त्वरितास्तत्र राक्षसा रावणाज्ञया। मद्यं भक्ष्यांश्च विविधान्क्षिप्रमेवोपहारयन्॥
en: Then the Rākşasas at the command of Rāvana speedily procured wine and various kinds of viands.

sa: यस्तु मेघ इवाकाशं महानावृत्य तिष्ठति। मध्ये वानरवीराणां सुराणामिव वासवः॥ भेरीणामिव संनादो यस्यैष श्रूयते महान्। घोषः शाखामृगेन्द्राणां संग्राममभिकाङ्क्षताम्॥ एष पर्वतमध्यास्ते पारयात्रमनुत्तमम्। युद्धे दुष्प्रसहो नित्यं पनसो नाम यूथपः॥ एनं शतसहस्राणां शतार्धं पर्युपासते। यूथपा यूथपश्रेष्ठं येषां यूथानि भागशः॥
en: And he that stay, like to a mighty mass of clouds covering up the sky, in the midst of the monkey-heroes, as does Vasava in the centre of the celestials, whose lofty shout is heard (mingled with the uproar set up by the foremost monkeys, burning for battle, dwell in the excellent hill Pārijātra; and, ever irrepressible in fight, is named Panasa, a leader of (monkey) bands. Fifty lacs of leaders with their forces arranged, environs this commander of monkeys.

sa: उक्तवाक्यं हनूमन्तमङ्गदस्तु तदाब्रवीत्॥ सर्वेषां हरिवीराणां मध्ये वाचमनुत्तमाम्।
en: When Hanumān had ended, Angada said these excellent words in the midst of the heroic monkeys.

sa: पृष्ठतो लक्ष्मणश्चैनमन्वगच्छत् समाहितः। सशरं चापमुद्यम्य सुमहविक्रमे रतः॥ तमन्वारोहत्सुग्रीवः सामात्यः सविभीषणः। ते वायुवेगप्रवणास्तं गिरि गिरिचारिणः।।।।
en: And Laksmana, collected, went in his wake. And, upraising bow and arrow, Sugriva, (ever) engaged in valorous acts, accompanied with Vibhişaņa as well as his counsellors, following him, also ascended (the mountain).

sa: ततोऽब्रवीन्महातेजाः सुग्रीवो वानरेश्वरः। अयं विज्ञापयंश्चापि हनूमन्तमिदं वचः॥
en: Then the exceedingly energetic lord of monkeys, Sugrīva, said to Hanumān these words fraught with import,

sa: हृष्टाः प्रमुदिता वीरा हरयः कामरूपिणः। तेषां प्रविशतां तत्र वानराणां महौजसाम्॥ पुष्पसंसर्गसुरभिर्ववौ प्राणसमोऽनिलः। अन्ये तु हरिवीराणां यूथानिष्क्रम्य यूथपाः।। सुग्रीवेणाभ्यनुज्ञाता लङ्का जग्मुः पताकिनीम्॥
en: As the exceedingly energetic monkeys entered, there blew upon them the breeze-like to life-redolent of perfume obtained from contact with the blossoms. And others of the leaders among the heroic monkeys, coming out from the bands, ordered by Sugriva, made in the direction of Lankā crowned with ensigns.

sa: एतावदुक्त्वा चोत्थाय काकुत्स्थः परमासनात्। पर्यष्वजत धर्मात्मा निरन्तरमुरोगतम्॥
en: Saying this, Rama, the descendant of Kākutstha rose up from his seat and embraced him cordially.

sa: प्रहृष्टाश्च सुराः सर्वे ऋषयश्च तपोधनाः। प्रशान्तं च जगत्सर्वं त्वत्प्रसादात्सुरेश्वर॥ सीता लक्ष्मीर्महाभागा संभूता वसुधातलात्। त्वदर्थमिह चोत्पन्ना जनकस्य गृहे प्रभो॥ लङ्कामानीय यत्नेन मातेव परिरक्षिता। एवमेतत्समाख्यातं तव राम महायशः॥ ममापि नारदेनोक्तमृषिणा दीर्घजीविना। यथा सनत्कुमारेण व्याख्यातं तस्य रक्षसः॥ तेनापि च तदेवाशु कृतं सर्वमशेषतः। यश्चतच्छ्रावयेच्छ्राद्धे विद्वान्ब्राह्मणसंनिधौ॥ अन्नं तदक्षयं दत्तं पितॄणामुपतिष्ठति। एतां श्रुत्वा कथां दिव्यां रामो राजीवलोचनः॥ परं विस्मयमापन्नो भ्रात
en: The Rşis, having piety for their wealth and all the deities have been pleased. O foremost of gods all this has been brought about by the flavours; and the whole universe has been pacified. Sita is the very presentation of Lakşmi, sprung from earth. It is for you that she has been born in the race of Janaka. Bringing her into Larkā Rāvana protected her with care like his mother. Rāma, I have thus related to you the entire story. Hearing this from the Rşi Sanatkumăra, the long-lived Närada described this to me. Daśānana, to a letter I followed the instructions of Sanatkumāra. Who ever listens to this story at the time of Sraddha, the rice, offered by him, becoming, inexhaustible, reaches his manes." Hearing this celestial theme, the lotus-eyed Rāma along with his brothers was greatly surpris

sa: सोऽसौ व्यसनमापन्नः कुम्भकर्णमबोधयत्। त्वत्पराक्रमभीतश्च राजा संप्रति रावणः॥
en: Now king Rāvaņa struck with terror at your prowess, encompassed with peril, has waked up Kumbhakarņa.

sa: हन्यतां दह्यतां वापि भक्ष्यतामिति चापरे। राक्षसास्तत्र संक्रुद्धाः परस्परमथाब्रुवन्॥ अतीत्य मार्ग सहसा महात्मा स तत्र रक्षोधिपपादमूले। ददर्श राज्ञः परिचारवृद्धान् गृहं महारत्नविभूषितं च।५७।।
en: And others said, "Kill him," "Burn him," "Eat him up". The Raksasas, growing enraged, thus said to each other. Having passed some way, that magnanimous one saw there old servants sitting at the feet of the lord of Rākşasas, as well as a mansion embellished with countless jewels.

sa: प्रविश्य शापोपहतां हरीश्वरः पुरीं शुभां राक्षसमुख्यपालिताम्। यदृच्छया त्वं जनकात्मजां सतीं विमार्ग सर्वत्र गतो यथासुखम्॥
en: Entering this splendid city lying under an imprecation, governed by the chief of the Rāks asas, do you at your will happily repairing everywhere, search for the chaste daughter of Janaka. .

sa: दक्षिणस्योदधेस्तीरे त्रिकूटो नाम पर्वतः। तस्याने तु विशाला सा महेन्द्रस्य पुरी यथा॥ लङ्का नाम पुरी रम्या निर्मिता विश्वकर्मणा। राक्षसानां निवासार्थं यथेन्द्रस्यामरावती॥ तब त्वं वस भद्रं ते लङ्कायां नात्र संशयः। हेमप्राकारपरिखा यन्त्रशस्त्रसमावृता॥ रमणीया पुरी सा हि रुक्मवैदूर्यतोरणा।
en: On the shore of the Southern sea there is a mount named Trikūta. On its brow is a beautiful and broad city built by Viśvakarmā, named Lankā, resembling the city itself of Indra the great, designed for the abode of Rākşasas, like to the Amaravati of Indra. There in Lanka, do you, forsooth, reside. That romantic city is surrounded with a golden wall and a moat, and is furnished with engines and weapons, and has gateways of gold and lapises.

sa: ततः पावकसंकाशैः शरैराशीविषोपमैः। वानराणामनीकानि बिभेद समरे प्रभुः॥
en: Then that lord pierced the monkey-hosts in the encounter with shafts resembling fire or venomous serpents.

sa: राघवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा लक्ष्मणः सविभीषणः। जग्राह कार्मुकश्रेष्ठमन्यद्भीमपराक्रमः॥
en: Then hearing Rāghava's words, Lakşmaņa endowed with dreadful prowess, with Vibhīşaņa, took up another excellent bow.

sa: ततः पादपसंबाधं नानावनसमायुतम्। सह्यपर्वतमासाद्य वानरास्ते समारुहन्।७० ।।
en: Thereupon, getting at the mount Sahya covered with various trees and forests, those monkeys ascended it.

sa: प्रीयमाणैः प्लवङ्गैस्तु सर्वे प्रयाकुलीकृताः। वाप्यस्तस्मिनिगरौ रम्याः पल्वलानि तथैव च।॥ चक्रवाकानुचारिताः कारण्डवनिषेविताः। प्लवैः क्रौञ्चैश्च संकीर्णा वराहमृगसेविताः॥ ऋक्षस्तरक्षुभिः सिंहै: शार्दूलश्च भयावहैः। व्यालैश्च बहुभिर्भीमैः सेव्यमानाः समन्ततः।॥ पद्मः सौगन्धिकैः फुल्लैः कुमुदैश्चौत्पलैस्तथा। वारिजैविविधैः पुष्पै रम्यास्तन जलाशयाः॥
en: All these trees were greatly disturbed by those monkeys, delighted with their view. There were in that mountain many a picturesque lake and pond filled with Cakravākas and Kārandavas, ducks, Krauñcas and the mount abounded on all sides with boars, deer, and terrible bears, lions and tigers and various other fearful animals, and it was beautified with full blown lotuses, Jilies, Utpalas and various other fragrant trees growing in the water.

sa: ररास भूमिर्न तताप भानुमान् ववौन न वायुः प्रचचाल चाचलः। कपेः कुमारस्य च वीर्यसंयुगं ननाद च द्यौरुदधिश्च चुक्षुभे॥
en: And witnessing the mighty conflict of the prince and the monkey, Earth emitted cries, and the Sun did not burn, and the Wind did not blow, and the mountains shook, and the welkin sounded, and the main was vexed.

sa: इति प्रतिसमादिष्टो हनूमान्मारुतात्मजः। मानुषं धारयन्रूपमयोध्यां त्वरितो ययौ॥
en: Being thus commanded, Hanumān, the son of Wind-god, assuming a human shape speedily proceeded towards Ayodhyā.

sa: एवमुक्तस्तु वैदेह्या प्रत्युवाच प्लवंगमः। प्रगृहीताञ्जलिहर्षात्सीतायाः प्रमुखे स्थितः॥
en: Being thus addressed by Vaidehi the monkeys replied-folding his hands with delight and stationed before Sītā.
